verses.arabic: الٓمٓ
verses.latinEn: Alif-lam-meem
verses.latinId: Alif lām mīm.

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ ٱلْقَيُّومُ
verses.latinEn: Allahu la ilaha illahuwa alhayyu alqayyoom
verses.latinId: Allāhu lā ilāha illā huwal-ḥayyul-qayyūm(u).

verses.arabic: نَزَّلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ بِٱلْحَقِّ مُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَيْهِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.latinEn: Nazzala AAalayka alkitaba bilhaqqimusaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi waanzala attawratawal-injeel
verses.latinId: Nazzala ‘alaikal-kitāba bil-ḥaqqi muṣaddiqal limā baina yadaihi wa anzalat-taurāta wal-injīl(a).

verses.arabic: مِن قَبْلُ هُدًى لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَنزَلَ ٱلْفُرْقَانَ ۗ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ شَدِيدٌ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَزِيزٌ ذُو ٱنتِقَامٍ
verses.latinEn: Min qablu hudan linnasiwaanzala alfurqana inna allatheena kafaroo bi-ayatiAllahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun wallahuAAazeezun thoo intiqam
verses.latinId: Min qablu hudal lin-nāsi wa anzalal-furqān(a), innal-lażīna kafarū bi āyātillāhi lahum ‘ażābun syadīd(un), wallāhu ‘azīzun żuntiqām(in).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَيْهِ شَىْءٌ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَلَا فِى ٱلسَّمَآءِ
verses.latinEn: Inna Allaha la yakhfaAAalayhi shay-on fee al-ardi wala fee assama/-
verses.latinId: Innallāha lā yakhfā ‘alaihi syai'un fil-arḍi wa lā fis-samā'(i).

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُصَوِّرُكُمْ فِى ٱلْأَرْحَامِ كَيْفَ يَشَآءُ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.latinEn: Huwa allathee yusawwirukum feeal-arhami kayfa yashao la ilaha illahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeem
verses.latinId: Huwal-lażī yuṣawwirukum fil-arḥāmi kaifa yasyā'(u), lā ilāha illā huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).

verses.arabic: هُوَ ٱلَّذِىٓ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ مِنْهُ ءَايَـٰتٌ مُّحْكَمَـٰتٌ هُنَّ أُمُّ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَأُخَرُ مُتَشَـٰبِهَـٰتٌ ۖ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ زَيْغٌ فَيَتَّبِعُونَ مَا تَشَـٰبَهَ مِنْهُ ٱبْتِغَآءَ ٱلْفِتْنَةِ وَٱبْتِغَآءَ تَأْوِيلِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا يَعْلَمُ تَأْوِيلَهُۥٓ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَٱلرَّٰسِخُونَ فِى ٱلْعِلْمِ يَقُولُونَ ءَامَنَّا بِهِۦ كُلٌّ مِّنْ عِندِ رَبِّنَا ۗ وَمَا يَذَّكَّرُ إِلَّآ أُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْأَلْبَـٰبِ
verses.latinEn: Huwa allathee anzala AAalayka alkitabaminhu ayatun muhkamatun hunna ommualkitabi waokharu mutashabihatun faammaallatheena fee quloobihim zayghun fayattabiAAoona matashabaha minhu ibtighaa alfitnati wabtighaata/weelihi wama yaAAlamu ta/weelahu illa Allahuwarrasikhoona fee alAAilmi yaqooloona amannabihi kullun min AAindi rabbina wama yaththakkaruilla oloo al-albab
verses.latinId: Huwal-lażī anzala ‘alaikal-kitāba minhu āyātum muḥkamātun hunna ummul-kitābi wa ukharu mutasyābihāt(un), fa'ammal-lażīna fī qulūbihim zaigun fayattabi‘ūna mā tasyābaha minhubtigā'al-fitnati wabtigā'a ta'wīlih(ī), wa mā ya‘lamu ta'wīlahū illallāh(u), war-rāsikhūna fil-‘ilmi yaqūlūna āmannā bih(ī), kullum min ‘indi rabbinā, wa mā yażżakkaru illā ulul-albāb(i).

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَا لَا تُزِغْ قُلُوبَنَا بَعْدَ إِذْ هَدَيْتَنَا وَهَبْ لَنَا مِن لَّدُنكَ رَحْمَةً ۚ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْوَهَّابُ
verses.latinEn: Rabbana la tuzigh quloobanabaAAda ith hadaytana wahab lana min ladunkarahmatan innaka anta alwahhab
verses.latinId: Rabbanā lā tuzig qulūbanā ba‘da iż hadaitanā wa hab lanā mil ladunka raḥmah(tan), innaka antal-wahhāb(u).

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ إِنَّكَ جَامِعُ ٱلنَّاسِ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُخْلِفُ ٱلْمِيعَادَ
verses.latinEn: Rabbana innaka jamiAAu annasiliyawmin la rayba feehi inna Allaha layukhlifu almeeAAad
verses.latinId: Rabbanā innaka jāmi‘un-nāsi liyaumil lā raiba fīh(i), innallāha lā yukhliful-mī‘ād(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمْ وَقُودُ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniyaAAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahishay-an waola-ika hum waqoodu annar
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna kafarū lan tugniya ‘anhum amwāluhum wa lā aulāduhum minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa ulā'ika hum waqūdun-nār(i).

verses.arabic: كَدَأْبِ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ ۚ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِـَٔايَـٰتِنَا فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
verses.latinEn: Kada/bi ali firAAawna wallatheenamin qablihim kaththaboo bi-ayatinafaakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim wallahushadeedu alAAiqab
verses.latinId: Kada'bi āli fir‘aun(a), wal-lażīna min qablihim, każżabū bi'āyātinā, fa'akhażahumullāhu biżunūbihim, wallāhu syadīdul-‘iqāb(i).

verses.arabic: قُل لِّلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ سَتُغْلَبُونَ وَتُحْشَرُونَ إِلَىٰ جَهَنَّمَ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمِهَادُ
verses.latinEn: Qul lillatheena kafaroo satughlaboonawatuhsharoona ila jahannama wabi/sa almihad
verses.latinId: Qul lil-lażīna kafarū satuglabūna wa tuḥsyarūna ilā jahannam(a), wa bi'sal-mihād(u).

verses.arabic: قَدْ كَانَ لَكُمْ ءَايَةٌ فِى فِئَتَيْنِ ٱلْتَقَتَا ۖ فِئَةٌ تُقَـٰتِلُ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَأُخْرَىٰ كَافِرَةٌ يَرَوْنَهُم مِّثْلَيْهِمْ رَأْىَ ٱلْعَيْنِ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يُؤَيِّدُ بِنَصْرِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَعِبْرَةً لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَبْصَـٰرِ
verses.latinEn: Qad kana lakum ayatun feefi-atayni iltaqata fi-atun tuqatilu fee sabeeli Allahiwaokhra kafiratun yarawnahum mithlayhim ra/yaalAAayni wallahu yu-ayyidu binasrihi manyashao inna fee thalika laAAibratan li-olee al-absar
verses.latinId: Qad kāna lakum āyatun fī fi'atainil taqatā, fi'atun tuqātilu fī sabīlillāhi wa ukhrā kāfiratuy yaraunahum miṡlaihim ra'yal-‘ain(i), wallāhu yu'ayyidu binaṣrihī may yasyā'(u), inna fī żālika la‘ibratal li'ulil-abṣār(i).

verses.arabic: زُيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ حُبُّ ٱلشَّهَوَٰتِ مِنَ ٱلنِّسَآءِ وَٱلْبَنِينَ وَٱلْقَنَـٰطِيرِ ٱلْمُقَنطَرَةِ مِنَ ٱلذَّهَبِ وَٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلْخَيْلِ ٱلْمُسَوَّمَةِ وَٱلْأَنْعَـٰمِ وَٱلْحَرْثِ ۗ ذَٰلِكَ مَتَـٰعُ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا ۖ وَٱللَّهُ عِندَهُۥ حُسْنُ ٱلْمَـَٔابِ
verses.latinEn: Zuyyina linnasi hubbuashshahawati mina annisa-i walbaneenawalqanateeri almuqantarati mina aththahabiwalfiddati walkhayli almusawwamati wal-anAAamiwalharthi thalika mataAAu alhayatiaddunya wallahu AAindahu husnualmaab
verses.latinId: Zuyyina lin-nāsi ḥubbusy-syahawāti minan-nisā'i wal-banīna wal-qanāṭīril-muqanṭarati minaż-żahabi wal-fiḍḍati wal-khailil-musawwamati wal-an‘āmi wal-ḥarṡ(i), żālika matā‘ul-ḥayātid-dun-yā, wallāhu ‘indahū ḥusnul-ma'āb(i).

verses.arabic: ۞ قُلْ أَؤُنَبِّئُكُم بِخَيْرٍ مِّن ذَٰلِكُمْ ۚ لِلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ عِندَ رَبِّهِمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا وَأَزْوَٰجٌ مُّطَهَّرَةٌ وَرِضْوَٰنٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.latinEn: Qul aonabbi-okum bikhayrin min thalikumlillatheena ittaqaw AAinda rabbihim jannatun tajreemin tahtiha al-anharu khalideena feehawaazwajun mutahharatun waridwanunmina Allahi wallahu baseerun bilAAibad
verses.latinId: Qul a'unabbi'ukum bikhairim min żālikum, lil-lażīnattaqau ‘inda rabbihim jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wa azwājum muṭahharatuw wa riḍwānum minallāh(i), wallāhu baṣīrum bil-‘ibād(i).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يَقُولُونَ رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا فَٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَقِنَا عَذَابَ ٱلنَّارِ
verses.latinEn: Allatheena yaqooloona rabbanainnana amanna faghfir lana thunoobanawaqina AAathaba annar
verses.latinId: Allażīna yaqūlūna rabbanā innanā āmannā fagfir lanā żunūbanā wa qinā ‘ażāban-nār(i).

verses.arabic: ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ وَٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ وَٱلْقَـٰنِتِينَ وَٱلْمُنفِقِينَ وَٱلْمُسْتَغْفِرِينَ بِٱلْأَسْحَارِ
verses.latinEn: Assabireena wassadiqeenawalqaniteena walmunfiqeena walmustaghfireenabil-ashar
verses.latinId: Aṣ-ṣābirīna waṣ-ṣādiqīna wal-qāniṭīna wal-munfiqīna wal-mustagfirīna bil-asḥār(i).

verses.arabic: شَهِدَ ٱللَّهُ أَنَّهُۥ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَأُو۟لُوا۟ ٱلْعِلْمِ قَآئِمًۢا بِٱلْقِسْطِ ۚ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.latinEn: Shahida Allahu annahu la ilahailla huwa walmala-ikatu waoloo alAAilmi qa-imanbilqisti la ilaha illa huwaalAAazeezu alhakeem
verses.latinId: Syahidallāhu annahū lā ilāha illā huw(a), wal-malā'ikatu wa ulul-‘ilmi qā'imam bil-qisṭ(i), lā ilāha illā huwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلدِّينَ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمُ ۗ وَمَا ٱخْتَلَفَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْعِلْمُ بَغْيًۢا بَيْنَهُمْ ۗ وَمَن يَكْفُرْ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
verses.latinEn: Inna addeena AAinda Allahial-islamu wama ikhtalafa allatheena ootooalkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaahumualAAilmu baghyan baynahum waman yakfur bi-ayati Allahifa-inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisab
verses.latinId: Innad-dīna ‘indallāhil-islām(u), wa makhtalafal-lażīna ūtul-kitāba illā mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-‘ilmu bagyam bainahum, wa may yakfur bi'āyātillāhi fa innallāha sarī‘ul-ḥisāb(i).

verses.arabic: فَإِنْ حَآجُّوكَ فَقُلْ أَسْلَمْتُ وَجْهِىَ لِلَّهِ وَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَنِ ۗ وَقُل لِّلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ ءَأَسْلَمْتُمْ ۚ فَإِنْ أَسْلَمُوا۟ فَقَدِ ٱهْتَدَوا۟ ۖ وَّإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّمَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْبَلَـٰغُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.latinEn: Fa-in hajjooka faqul aslamtu wajhiyalillahi wamani ittabaAAani waqul lillatheena ootooalkitaba walommiyyeena aaslamtum fa-inaslamoo faqadi ihtadaw wa-in tawallaw fa-innama AAalaykaalbalaghu wallahu baseerun bilAAibad
verses.latinId: Fa'in ḥājjūka fa qul aslamtu wajhiya lillāhi wa manittaba‘an(i), wa qul lil-lażīna ūtul-kitāba wal-ummiyyīna a'aslamtum, fa'in aslamū faqadihtadau, wa in tawallau fa'innamā ‘alaikal-balāg(u), wallāhu baṣīrum bil-‘ibād(i).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْقِسْطِ مِنَ ٱلنَّاسِ فَبَشِّرْهُم بِعَذَابٍ أَلِيمٍ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena yakfuroona bi-ayatiAllahi wayaqtuloona annabiyyeena bighayri haqqinwayaqtuloona allatheena ya/muroona bilqistimina annasi fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleem
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna yakfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa yaqtulūnan nabiyyīna bigairi ḥaqq(in), wa yaqtulūnal-lażīna ya'murūna bil-qisṭi minan-nās(i), fabasysyirhum bi‘ażābin alīm(in).

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ ٱلَّذِينَ حَبِطَتْ أَعْمَـٰلُهُمْ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ola-ika allatheena habitataAAmaluhum fee addunya wal-akhiratiwama lahum min nasireen
verses.latinId: Ulā'ikal-lażīna ḥabiṭat a‘māluhum fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).

verses.arabic: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ يُدْعَوْنَ إِلَىٰ كِتَـٰبِ ٱللَّهِ لِيَحْكُمَ بَيْنَهُمْ ثُمَّ يَتَوَلَّىٰ فَرِيقٌ مِّنْهُمْ وَهُم مُّعْرِضُونَ
verses.latinEn: Alam tara ila allatheena ootoonaseeban mina alkitabi yudAAawna ila kitabiAllahi liyahkuma baynahum thumma yatawallafareequn minhum wahum muAAridoon
verses.latinId: Alam tara ilal-lażīna ūtū naṣībam minal-kitābi yud‘auna ilā kitābillāhi liyaḥkuma bainahum ṡumma yatawallā farīqum minhum wa hum mu‘riḍūn(a).

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَن تَمَسَّنَا ٱلنَّارُ إِلَّآ أَيَّامًا مَّعْدُودَٰتٍ ۖ وَغَرَّهُمْ فِى دِينِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَفْتَرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Thalika bi-annahum qaloo lantamassana annaru illa ayyamanmaAAdoodatin wagharrahum fee deenihim ma kanooyaftaroon
verses.latinId: Żālika bi'annahum qālū lan tamassanan nāru illā ayyāmam ma‘dūdāt(in), wa garrahum fī dīnihim mā kānū yaftarūn(a).

verses.arabic: فَكَيْفَ إِذَا جَمَعْنَـٰهُمْ لِيَوْمٍ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهِ وَوُفِّيَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Fakayfa itha jamaAAnahumliyawmin la rayba feehi wawuffiyat kullu nafsin makasabat wahum la yuthlamoon
verses.latinId: Fakaifa iżā jama‘nāhum liyaumil lā raiba fīh(i), wa wuffiyat kullu nafsim mā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلِ ٱللَّهُمَّ مَـٰلِكَ ٱلْمُلْكِ تُؤْتِى ٱلْمُلْكَ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتَنزِعُ ٱلْمُلْكَ مِمَّن تَشَآءُ وَتُعِزُّ مَن تَشَآءُ وَتُذِلُّ مَن تَشَآءُ ۖ بِيَدِكَ ٱلْخَيْرُ ۖ إِنَّكَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Quli allahumma malika almulkitu/tee almulka man tashao watanziAAu almulka mimman tashaowatuAAizzu man tashao watuthillu man tashaobiyadika alkhayru innaka AAala kulli shay-in qadeer
verses.latinId: Qulillāhumma mālikal-mulki tu'til-mulka man tasyā'u wa tanzi‘ul-mulka mim man tasyā'(u), wa tu‘izzu man tasyā'u wa tużillu man tasyā'(u), biyadikal-khair(u), innaka ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).

verses.arabic: تُولِجُ ٱلَّيْلَ فِى ٱلنَّهَارِ وَتُولِجُ ٱلنَّهَارَ فِى ٱلَّيْلِ ۖ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْحَىَّ مِنَ ٱلْمَيِّتِ وَتُخْرِجُ ٱلْمَيِّتَ مِنَ ٱلْحَىِّ ۖ وَتَرْزُقُ مَن تَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.latinEn: Tooliju allayla fee annahariwatooliju annahara fee allayli watukhriju alhayyamina almayyiti watukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi watarzuquman tashao bighayri hisab
verses.latinId: Tūlijul-laila fin-nahāri wa tūlijun-nahāra fil-laili wa tukhrijul-ḥayya minal-mayyiti wa tukhrijul-mayyita minal-ḥayyi wa tarzuqu man tasyā'u bigairi ḥisāb(in).

verses.arabic: لَّا يَتَّخِذِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ أَوْلِيَآءَ مِن دُونِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ ۖ وَمَن يَفْعَلْ ذَٰلِكَ فَلَيْسَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ فِى شَىْءٍ إِلَّآ أَن تَتَّقُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ تُقَىٰةً ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.latinEn: La yattakhithi almu/minoonaalkafireena awliyaa min dooni almu/mineena wamanyafAAal thalika falaysa mina Allahi fee shay-in illaan tattaqoo minhum tuqatan wayuhaththirukumuAllahu nafsahu wa-ila Allahi almaseer
verses.latinId: Lā yattakhiżil-mu'minūnal-kāfirīna auliyā'a min dūnil-mu'minīn(a), wa may yaf‘al żālika falaisa minallāhi fī syai'(in), illā an tattaqū minhum tuqāh(tan), wa yuḥażżirukumullāhu nafsah(ū), wa ilallāhil-maṣīr(u).

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن تُخْفُوا۟ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ أَوْ تُبْدُوهُ يَعْلَمْهُ ٱللَّهُ ۗ وَيَعْلَمُ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Qul in tukhfoo ma fee sudoorikumaw tubdoohu yaAAlamhu Allahu wayaAAlamu ma fee assamawatiwama fee al-ardi wallahu AAalakulli shay-in qadeer
verses.latinId: Qul in tukhfū mā fī ṣudūrikum  au tubdūhu ya‘lamhullāh(u), wa ya‘lamu mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wallāhu ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَجِدُ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتْ مِنْ خَيْرٍ مُّحْضَرًا وَمَا عَمِلَتْ مِن سُوٓءٍ تَوَدُّ لَوْ أَنَّ بَيْنَهَا وَبَيْنَهُۥٓ أَمَدًۢا بَعِيدًا ۗ وَيُحَذِّرُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ نَفْسَهُۥ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ رَءُوفٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
verses.latinEn: Yawma tajidu kullu nafsin ma AAamilatmin khayrin muhdaran wama AAamilat min soo-intawaddu law anna baynaha wabaynahu amadan baAAeedan wayuhaththirukumuAllahu nafsahu wallahu raoofun bilAAibad
verses.latinId: Yauma tajidu kullu nafsim mā ‘amilat min khairim muḥḍarā(n), wa mā ‘amilat min sū'(in), tawaddu lau anna bainahā wa bainahū amadam ba‘īdā(n), wa yuḥażżirukumullāhu nafsah(ū), wallāhu ra'ūfum bil-‘ibād(i).

verses.arabic: قُلْ إِن كُنتُمْ تُحِبُّونَ ٱللَّهَ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى يُحْبِبْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَيَغْفِرْ لَكُمْ ذُنُوبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Qul in kuntum tuhibboona AllahafattabiAAoonee yuhbibkumu Allahu wayaghfirlakum thunoobakum wallahu ghafoorun raheem
verses.latinId: Qul in kuntum tuḥibbūnallāha fattabi‘ūnī yuḥbibkumullāhu wa yagfir lakum żunūbakum, wallāhu gafūrur raḥīm(un).

verses.arabic: قُلْ أَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ ۖ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Qul ateeAAoo Allaha warrasoolafa-in tawallaw fa-inna Allaha la yuhibbu alkafireen
verses.latinId: Qul aṭī‘ullāha war-rasūl(a), fa'in tawallau fa innallāha lā yuḥibbul-kāfirīn(a).

verses.arabic: ۞ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ وَنُوحًا وَءَالَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَءَالَ عِمْرَٰنَ عَلَى ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Inna Allaha istafa adamawanoohan waala ibraheema waala AAimranaAAala alAAalameen
verses.latinId: Innallāhaṣṭafā ādama wa nūḥaw wa āla ibrāhīma wa āla ‘imrāna ‘alal-‘ālamīn(a).

verses.arabic: ذُرِّيَّةًۢ بَعْضُهَا مِنۢ بَعْضٍ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Thurriyyatan baAAduhamin baAAdin wallahu sameeAAun AAaleem
verses.latinId: Żurriyyatam ba‘ḍuhā mim ba‘ḍ(in), wallāhu samī‘un ‘alīm(un).

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱمْرَأَتُ عِمْرَٰنَ رَبِّ إِنِّى نَذَرْتُ لَكَ مَا فِى بَطْنِى مُحَرَّرًا فَتَقَبَّلْ مِنِّىٓ ۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْعَلِيمُ
verses.latinEn: Ith qalati imraatu AAimranarabbi innee nathartu laka ma fee batnee muharraranfataqabbal minnee innaka anta assameeAAu alAAaleem
verses.latinId: Iż qālatimra'atu ‘imrāna rabbi innī nażartu laka mā fī baṭnī muḥarraran fataqabbal minnī, innaka antas-samī‘ul-‘alīm(u).

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّا وَضَعَتْهَا قَالَتْ رَبِّ إِنِّى وَضَعْتُهَآ أُنثَىٰ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا وَضَعَتْ وَلَيْسَ ٱلذَّكَرُ كَٱلْأُنثَىٰ ۖ وَإِنِّى سَمَّيْتُهَا مَرْيَمَ وَإِنِّىٓ أُعِيذُهَا بِكَ وَذُرِّيَّتَهَا مِنَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنِ ٱلرَّجِيمِ
verses.latinEn: Falamma wadaAAat-ha qalatrabbi innee wadaAAtuha ontha wallahuaAAlamu bima wadaAAat walaysa aththakarukalontha wa-innee sammaytuha maryamawa-innee oAAeethuha bika wathurriyyatahamina ashshaytani arrajeem
verses.latinId: Falammā waḍa‘athā qālat rabbi innī waḍa‘tuhā unṡā, wallāhu a‘lamu bimā waḍa‘at, wa laisaż-żakaru kal-unṡā, wa innī sammaituhā maryama wa innī u‘īżuhā bika wa żurriyyatahā minasy-syaiṭānir-rajīm(i).

verses.arabic: فَتَقَبَّلَهَا رَبُّهَا بِقَبُولٍ حَسَنٍ وَأَنۢبَتَهَا نَبَاتًا حَسَنًا وَكَفَّلَهَا زَكَرِيَّا ۖ كُلَّمَا دَخَلَ عَلَيْهَا زَكَرِيَّا ٱلْمِحْرَابَ وَجَدَ عِندَهَا رِزْقًا ۖ قَالَ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ أَنَّىٰ لَكِ هَـٰذَا ۖ قَالَتْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يَرْزُقُ مَن يَشَآءُ بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
verses.latinEn: Fataqabbalaha rabbuhabiqaboolin hasanin waanbataha nabatan hasananwakaffalaha zakariyya kullama dakhalaAAalayha zakariyya almihraba wajadaAAindaha rizqan qala ya maryamu annalaki hatha qalat huwa min AAindi Allahi innaAllaha yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisab
verses.latinId: Fataqabbalahā rabbuhā biqabūlin ḥasaniw wa ambatahā nabātan ḥasanā(n), wa kaffalahā zakariyyā, kullamā dakhala ‘alaihā zakariyyal-miḥrāba wajada ‘indahā rizqā(n), qāla yā maryama annā laki hāżā, qālat huwa min ‘indillāh(i), innallāha yarzuqu may yasyā'u bigairi ḥisāb(in).

verses.arabic: هُنَالِكَ دَعَا زَكَرِيَّا رَبَّهُۥ ۖ قَالَ رَبِّ هَبْ لِى مِن لَّدُنكَ ذُرِّيَّةً طَيِّبَةً ۖ إِنَّكَ سَمِيعُ ٱلدُّعَآءِ
verses.latinEn: Hunalika daAAa zakariyyarabbahu qala rabbi hab lee min ladunka thurriyyatantayyibatan innaka sameeAAu adduAAa/-
verses.latinId: Hunālika da‘ā zakariyyā rabbahū qāla rabbi hab lī mil ladunka żurriyyatan ṭayyibah(tan), innaka samī‘ud-du‘ā'(i).

verses.arabic: فَنَادَتْهُ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُوَ قَآئِمٌ يُصَلِّى فِى ٱلْمِحْرَابِ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكَ بِيَحْيَىٰ مُصَدِّقًۢا بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَسَيِّدًا وَحَصُورًا وَنَبِيًّا مِّنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.latinEn: Fanadat-hu almala-ikatu wahuwaqa-imun yusallee fee almihrabi annaAllaha yubashshiruka biyahya musaddiqanbikalimatin mina Allahi wasayyidan wahasooranwanabiyyan mina assaliheen
verses.latinId: Fanādathul-malā'ikatu wa huwa qā'imuy yuṣallī fil-miḥrāb(i), annallāha yubasysyiruka biyaḥyā muṣaddiqam bikalimatim minallāhi wa sayyidaw wa ḥaṣūraw wa nabiyyam minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى غُلَـٰمٌ وَقَدْ بَلَغَنِىَ ٱلْكِبَرُ وَٱمْرَأَتِى عَاقِرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱللَّهُ يَفْعَلُ مَا يَشَآءُ
verses.latinEn: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu leeghulamun waqad balaghaniya alkibaru wamraatee AAaqirunqala kathalika Allahu yafAAalu mayasha/
verses.latinId: Qāla rabbi annā yakūnu lī gulāmuw wa qad balaganīyal-kibaru wamra'atī ‘āqir(un), qāla każālikallāhu yaf‘alu mā yasyā'(u).

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱجْعَل لِّىٓ ءَايَةً ۖ قَالَ ءَايَتُكَ أَلَّا تُكَلِّمَ ٱلنَّاسَ ثَلَـٰثَةَ أَيَّامٍ إِلَّا رَمْزًا ۗ وَٱذْكُر رَّبَّكَ كَثِيرًا وَسَبِّحْ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَـٰرِ
verses.latinEn: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qalaayatuka alla tukallima annasa thalathataayyamin illa ramzan wathkur rabbakakatheeran wasabbih bilAAashiyyi wal-ibkar
verses.latinId: Qāla rabbij‘al lī āyah(tan), qāla āyatuka allā tukalliman-nāsa  ṡalāṡata ayyāmin illā ramzā(n), ważkur rabbaka kaṡīraw wa sabbiḥ bil-‘asyiyyi wal-ibkār(i).

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ ٱصْطَفَىٰكِ وَطَهَّرَكِ وَٱصْطَفَىٰكِ عَلَىٰ نِسَآءِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wa-ith qalati almala-ikatuya maryamu inna Allaha istafaki watahharakiwastafaki AAala nisa-i alAAalameen
verses.latinId: Wa iż qālatil-malā'ikatu yā maryama innallāhaṣṭafāki wa ṭahharaki waṣṭafāki ‘alā nisā'il-‘ālamīn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰمَرْيَمُ ٱقْنُتِى لِرَبِّكِ وَٱسْجُدِى وَٱرْكَعِى مَعَ ٱلرَّٰكِعِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ya maryamu oqnutee lirabbiki wasjudeewarkaAAee maAAa arrakiAAeen
verses.latinId: Yā maryamuqnutī lirabbiki wasjudī warka‘ī ma‘ar-rāki‘īn(a).

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ ٱلْغَيْبِ نُوحِيهِ إِلَيْكَ ۚ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يُلْقُونَ أَقْلَـٰمَهُمْ أَيُّهُمْ يَكْفُلُ مَرْيَمَ وَمَا كُنتَ لَدَيْهِمْ إِذْ يَخْتَصِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Thalika min anba-i alghaybinooheehi ilayka wama kunta ladayhim ithyulqoona aqlamahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryama wamakunta ladayhim ith yakhtasimoon
verses.latinId: Żālika min ambā'il-gaibi nūḥīhi ilaik(a), wa mā kunta ladaihim iż yulqūna aqlāmahum ayyuhum yakfulu maryam(a), wa mā kunta ladaihim iż yakhtaṣimūn(a).

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَتِ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةُ يَـٰمَرْيَمُ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُبَشِّرُكِ بِكَلِمَةٍ مِّنْهُ ٱسْمُهُ ٱلْمَسِيحُ عِيسَى ٱبْنُ مَرْيَمَ وَجِيهًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمِنَ ٱلْمُقَرَّبِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ith qalati almala-ikatuya maryamu inna Allaha yubashshiruki bikalimatinminhu ismuhu almaseehu AAeesa ibnu maryama wajeehanfee addunya wal-akhirati waminaalmuqarrabeen
verses.latinId: Iż qālatil-malā'ikatu yā maryama innallāha yubasysyiruki bikalimatim minhusmuhul-masīḥu ‘īsabnu maryama wajīhan fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirati wa minal-muqarrabīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَيُكَلِّمُ ٱلنَّاسَ فِى ٱلْمَهْدِ وَكَهْلًا وَمِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wayukallimu annasa feealmahdi wakahlan wamina assaliheen
verses.latinId: Wa yukallimun nāsa fil-mahdi wa kahlaw wa minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).

verses.arabic: قَالَتْ رَبِّ أَنَّىٰ يَكُونُ لِى وَلَدٌ وَلَمْ يَمْسَسْنِى بَشَرٌ ۖ قَالَ كَذَٰلِكِ ٱللَّهُ يَخْلُقُ مَا يَشَآءُ ۚ إِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.latinEn: Qalat rabbi anna yakoonu leewaladun walam yamsasnee basharun qala kathaliki Allahuyakhluqu ma yashao itha qada amranfa-innama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
verses.latinId: Qālat rabbi annā yakūnu lī waladuw wa lam yamsasnī basyar(un), qāla każālikillāhu yakhluqu mā yasyā'(u), iżā qaḍā amran fa'innamā yaqūlu lahū kun fayakūn(u).

verses.arabic: وَيُعَلِّمُهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَٱلتَّوْرَىٰةَ وَٱلْإِنجِيلَ
verses.latinEn: WayuAAallimuhu alkitaba walhikmatawattawrata wal-injeel
verses.latinId: Wa ya‘allimuhul-kitāba wal-ḥikmata wat-taurāta wal-injīl(a).

verses.arabic: وَرَسُولًا إِلَىٰ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ أَنِّى قَدْ جِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ ۖ أَنِّىٓ أَخْلُقُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطِّينِ كَهَيْـَٔةِ ٱلطَّيْرِ فَأَنفُخُ فِيهِ فَيَكُونُ طَيْرًۢا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُبْرِئُ ٱلْأَكْمَهَ وَٱلْأَبْرَصَ وَأُحْىِ ٱلْمَوْتَىٰ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۖ وَأُنَبِّئُكُم بِمَا تَأْكُلُونَ وَمَا تَدَّخِرُونَ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ ۚ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَةً لَّكُمْ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Warasoolan ila banee isra-eelaannee qad ji/tukum bi-ayatin min rabbikum annee akhluqulakum mina atteeni kahay-ati attayrifaanfukhu feehi fayakoonu tayran bi-ithni Allahiwaobri-o al-akmaha wal-abrasa waohyeealmawta bi-ithni Allahi waonabbi-okum bimata/kuloona wama taddakhiroona fee buyootikum inna fee thalikalaayatan lakum in kuntum mu/mineen
verses.latinId: Wa rasūlan ilā banī isrā'īl(a), annī qad ji'tukum bi'āyatim mir rabbikum, annī akhluqu lakum minaṭ-ṭīni kahai'atiṭ-ṭairi fa'anfukhu  fihi fayakūnu ṭairam bi'iżnillāh(i), wa ubarri'ul-akmaha wal-abraṣa wa uḥyil-mautā bi'iżnillāh(i), wa unabbi'ukum bimā ta'kulūna wa mā taddakhirūna fī buyūtikum, inna fī żālika la'āyatal lakum in kuntum mu'minīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمُصَدِّقًا لِّمَا بَيْنَ يَدَىَّ مِنَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ وَلِأُحِلَّ لَكُم بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى حُرِّمَ عَلَيْكُمْ ۚ وَجِئْتُكُم بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَأَطِيعُونِ
verses.latinEn: Wamusaddiqan lima baynayadayya mina attawrati wali-ohilla lakumbaAAda allathee hurrima AAalaykum waji/tukumbi-ayatin min rabbikum fattaqoo Allaha waateeAAoon
verses.latinId: Wa muṣaddiqal limā baina yadayya minat-taurāti wa li'uḥilla lakum ba‘ḍal-lażī ḥurrima ‘alaikum wa ji'tukum bi'āyatim mir rabbikum, fattaqullāha wa aṭī‘ūn(i).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ رَبِّى وَرَبُّكُمْ فَٱعْبُدُوهُ ۗ هَـٰذَا صِرَٰطٌ مُّسْتَقِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Inna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faAAbudoohuhatha siratun mustaqeem
verses.latinId: Innallāha rabbī wa rabbukum fa‘budūh(u), hāżā ṣirāṭum mustaqīm(un).

verses.arabic: ۞ فَلَمَّآ أَحَسَّ عِيسَىٰ مِنْهُمُ ٱلْكُفْرَ قَالَ مَنْ أَنصَارِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ ۖ قَالَ ٱلْحَوَارِيُّونَ نَحْنُ أَنصَارُ ٱللَّهِ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَٱشْهَدْ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Falamma ahassa AAeesaminhumu alkufra qala man ansaree ila Allahiqala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaruAllahi amanna billahi washhadbi-anna muslimoon
verses.latinId: Falammā aḥassa ‘īsā minhumul-kufra qāla man anṣārī ilallāh(i), qālal-ḥawāriyyūna naḥnu anṣārullāh(i), āmannā billāh(i), wasyhad bi'annā muslimūn(a).

verses.arabic: رَبَّنَآ ءَامَنَّا بِمَآ أَنزَلْتَ وَٱتَّبَعْنَا ٱلرَّسُولَ فَٱكْتُبْنَا مَعَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.latinEn: Rabbana amanna bimaanzalta wattabaAAna arrasoola faktubnamaAAa ashshahideen
verses.latinId: Rabbanā āmannā bimā anzalta wattaba‘nar-rasūla faktubnā ma‘asy-syāhidīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَكَرُوا۟ وَمَكَرَ ٱللَّهُ ۖ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرُ ٱلْمَـٰكِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wamakaroo wamakara Allahu wallahukhayru almakireen
verses.latinId: Wa makarū wa makarallāh(u), wallāhu khairul-mākirīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِذْ قَالَ ٱللَّهُ يَـٰعِيسَىٰٓ إِنِّى مُتَوَفِّيكَ وَرَافِعُكَ إِلَىَّ وَمُطَهِّرُكَ مِنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَجَاعِلُ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوكَ فَوْقَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ يَوْمِ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۖ ثُمَّ إِلَىَّ مَرْجِعُكُمْ فَأَحْكُمُ بَيْنَكُمْ فِيمَا كُنتُمْ فِيهِ تَخْتَلِفُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ith qala Allahu yaAAeesa innee mutawaffeeka warafiAAuka ilayya wamutahhirukamina allatheena kafaroo wajaAAilu allatheenaittabaAAooka fawqa allatheena kafaroo ila yawmialqiyamati thumma ilayya marjiAAukum faahkumubaynakum feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoon
verses.latinId: Iż qālallāhu yā ‘īsā innī mutawaffīka wa rāfi‘uka ilayya wa muṭahhiruka minal-lażīna kafarū wa jā‘ilul-lażīnattaba‘ūka fauqal-lażīna kafarū ilā yaumil-qiyāmah(ti), ṡumma ilayya marji‘ukum fa aḥkumu bainakum fīmā kuntum fīhi takhtalifūn(a).

verses.arabic: فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَأُعَذِّبُهُمْ عَذَابًا شَدِيدًا فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Faamma allatheena kafaroofaoAAaththibuhum AAathaban shadeedan fee addunyawal-akhirati wama lahum min nasireen
verses.latinId: Fa ammal-lażīna kafarū fa u‘ażżibuhum ‘ażāban syadīdan fid-dun-yā wal-ākhirah(ti), wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَيُوَفِّيهِمْ أُجُورَهُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Waamma allatheena amanoowaAAamiloo assalihati fayuwaffeehimojoorahum wallahu la yuhibbu aththalimeen
verses.latinId: Wa ammal-lażīna āmanū wa ‘amiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa yuwaffīhim ujūrahum, wallāhu lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).

verses.arabic: ذَٰلِكَ نَتْلُوهُ عَلَيْكَ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ وَٱلذِّكْرِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.latinEn: Thalika natloohu AAalayka mina al-ayatiwaththikri alhakeem
verses.latinId: Żālika natlūhu ‘alaika minal-āyāti waż-żikril-ḥakīm(i).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ مَثَلَ عِيسَىٰ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَثَلِ ءَادَمَ ۖ خَلَقَهُۥ مِن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ قَالَ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
verses.latinEn: Inna mathala AAeesa AAinda Allahikamathali adama khalaqahu min turabin thumma qalalahu kun fayakoon
verses.latinId: Inna maṡala ‘īsā ‘indallāhi kamaṡali ādam(a), khalaqahū min turābin ṡumma qāla lahū kun fayakūn(u).

verses.arabic: ٱلْحَقُّ مِن رَّبِّكَ فَلَا تَكُن مِّنَ ٱلْمُمْتَرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Alhaqqu min rabbika fala takunmina almumtareen
verses.latinId: Al-ḥaqqu mir rabbika falā takum minal-mumtarīn(a).

verses.arabic: فَمَنْ حَآجَّكَ فِيهِ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَكَ مِنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ فَقُلْ تَعَالَوْا۟ نَدْعُ أَبْنَآءَنَا وَأَبْنَآءَكُمْ وَنِسَآءَنَا وَنِسَآءَكُمْ وَأَنفُسَنَا وَأَنفُسَكُمْ ثُمَّ نَبْتَهِلْ فَنَجْعَل لَّعْنَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَى ٱلْكَـٰذِبِينَ
verses.latinEn: Faman hajjaka feehi min baAAdi majaaka mina alAAilmi faqul taAAalaw nadAAu abnaanawaabnaakum wanisaana wanisaakumwaanfusana waanfusakum thumma nabtahil fanajAAal laAAnataAllahi AAala alkathibeen
verses.latinId: Faman ḥājjaka fīhi mim ba‘di mā jā'aka minal-‘ilmi faqul ta‘ālau nad‘u abnā'anā wa abnā'akum wa nisā'anā wa nisā'akum wa anfusanā wa anfusakum, ṡumma nabtahil fanaj‘al la‘natallāhi ‘alal-kāżibīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا لَهُوَ ٱلْقَصَصُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۚ وَمَا مِنْ إِلَـٰهٍ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ ۚ وَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَهُوَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
verses.latinEn: Inna hatha lahuwa alqasasualhaqqu wama min ilahin illa Allahuwa-inna Allaha lahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeem
verses.latinId: Inna hāżā lahuwal-qaṣaṣul-ḥaqq(u), wa mā min ilāhin illallāh(u), wa innallāha lahuwal-‘azīzul-ḥakīm(u).

verses.arabic: فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُفْسِدِينَ
verses.latinEn: Fa-in tawallaw fa-inna AllahaAAaleemun bilmufsideen
verses.latinId: Fa in tawallau fa innallāha ‘alīmum bil-mufsidīn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ تَعَالَوْا۟ إِلَىٰ كَلِمَةٍ سَوَآءٍۭ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكُمْ أَلَّا نَعْبُدَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهَ وَلَا نُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ شَيْـًٔا وَلَا يَتَّخِذَ بَعْضُنَا بَعْضًا أَرْبَابًا مِّن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ ۚ فَإِن تَوَلَّوْا۟ فَقُولُوا۟ ٱشْهَدُوا۟ بِأَنَّا مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Qul ya ahla alkitabi taAAalawila kalimatin sawa-in baynana wabaynakum allanaAAbuda illa Allaha wala nushrika bihishay-an wala yattakhitha baAAdunabaAAdan arbaban min dooni Allahi fa-intawallaw faqooloo ishhadoo bi-anna muslimoon
verses.latinId: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi ta‘ālau ilā kalimatin sawā'im bainanā wa bainakum allā na‘buda illallāha wa lā nusyrika bihī syai'aw wa lā yattakhiża ba‘ḍunā ba‘ḍan arbābam min dūnillāh(i), fa in tawallau fa qūlusyhadū bi'annā muslimūn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِىٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَمَآ أُنزِلَتِ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ وَٱلْإِنجِيلُ إِلَّا مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦٓ ۚ أَفَلَا تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ahla alkitabi lima tuhajjoonafee ibraheema wama onzilati attawratuwal-injeelu illa min baAAdihi afalataAAqiloon
verses.latinId: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima tuḥājjūna fī ibrāhīma wa mā unzilatit-taurātu wal-injīlu illā mim ba‘dih(ī), afalā ta‘qilūn(a).

verses.arabic: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ حَـٰجَجْتُمْ فِيمَا لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ فَلِمَ تُحَآجُّونَ فِيمَا لَيْسَ لَكُم بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ يَعْلَمُ وَأَنتُمْ لَا تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ha antum haola-i hajajtumfeema lakum bihi AAilmun falima tuhajjoona feemalaysa lakum bihi AAilmun wallahu yaAAlamu waantumla taAAlamoon
verses.latinId: Hā antum hā'ulā'i ḥājajtum fīmā lakum bihī ‘ilmun falima tuḥājjūna fīmā laisa lakum bihī ‘ilm(un), wallāhu ya‘lamu wa antum lā ta‘lamūn(a).

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ إِبْرَٰهِيمُ يَهُودِيًّا وَلَا نَصْرَانِيًّا وَلَـٰكِن كَانَ حَنِيفًا مُّسْلِمًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ma kana ibraheemuyahoodiyyan wala nasraniyyan walakinkana haneefan musliman wama kana minaalmushrikeen
verses.latinId: Wa mā kāna ibrāhīmu yahūdiyyaw wa lā naṣrāniyyaw wa lākin kāna ḥanīfam muslimā(n), wa mā kāna minal-musyrikīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَوْلَى ٱلنَّاسِ بِإِبْرَٰهِيمَ لَلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ وَهَـٰذَا ٱلنَّبِىُّ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَلِىُّ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Inna awla annasibi-ibraheema lallatheena ittabaAAoohu wahathaannabiyyu wallatheena amanoo wallahuwaliyyu almu/mineen
verses.latinId: Inna aulan-nāsi bi'ibrāhīma lal-lażīnattaba‘ūhu wa hāżan-nabiyyu wal-lażīna āmanū, wallāhu waliyyul-mu'minīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَدَّت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَوْ يُضِلُّونَكُمْ وَمَا يُضِلُّونَ إِلَّآ أَنفُسَهُمْ وَمَا يَشْعُرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Waddat ta-ifatun min ahli alkitabilaw yudilloonakum wama yudilloona illaanfusahum wama yashAAuroon
verses.latinId: Waddaṭ-ṭā'ifatum min ahlil-kitābi lau yuḍillūnakum, wa mā yuḍillūna illā anfusahum wa mā yasy‘urūn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَنتُمْ تَشْهَدُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ahla alkitabi limatakfuroona bi-ayati Allahi waantumtashhadoon
verses.latinId: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa antum tasyhadūn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَلْبِسُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ بِٱلْبَـٰطِلِ وَتَكْتُمُونَ ٱلْحَقَّ وَأَنتُمْ تَعْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ahla alkitabi limatalbisoona alhaqqa bilbatili wataktumoonaalhaqqa waantum taAAlamoon
verses.latinId: Yā ahlal-kitābi lima talbisūnal-ḥaqqa bil-bāṭili wa taktumūnal-ḥaqqa wa antum ta‘lamūn.

verses.arabic: وَقَالَت طَّآئِفَةٌ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ ءَامِنُوا۟ بِٱلَّذِىٓ أُنزِلَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَجْهَ ٱلنَّهَارِ وَٱكْفُرُوٓا۟ ءَاخِرَهُۥ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَرْجِعُونَ
verses.latinEn: Waqalat ta-ifatun min ahlialkitabi aminoo billathee onzilaAAala allatheena amanoo wajha annahariwakfuroo akhirahu laAAallahum yarjiAAoon
verses.latinId: Wa qālaṭ-ṭā'ifatum min ahlil-kitābi āminū bil-lażī unzila ‘alal-lażīna āmanū wajhan-nahāri wakfurū ākhirahū la‘allahum yarji‘ūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تُؤْمِنُوٓا۟ إِلَّا لِمَن تَبِعَ دِينَكُمْ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْهُدَىٰ هُدَى ٱللَّهِ أَن يُؤْتَىٰٓ أَحَدٌ مِّثْلَ مَآ أُوتِيتُمْ أَوْ يُحَآجُّوكُمْ عِندَ رَبِّكُمْ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ ٱللَّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ وَٰسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Wala tu/minoo illa limantabiAAa deenakum qul inna alhuda huda Allahian yu/ta ahadun mithla ma ooteetum aw yuhajjookumAAinda rabbikum qul inna alfadla biyadi Allahiyu/teehi man yashao wallahu wasiAAunAAaleem
verses.latinId: Wa lā tu'minū illā liman tabi‘a dīnakum, qul innal-hudā hudallāh(i), ay yu'tā aḥadum miṡla mā ūtītum au yuḥājjūkum ‘inda rabbikum, qul innal-faḍla biyadillāh(i), yu'tīhi may yasyā'(u), wallāhu wāsi‘un ‘alīm(un).

verses.arabic: يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِۦ مَن يَشَآءُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو ٱلْفَضْلِ ٱلْعَظِيمِ
verses.latinEn: Yakhtassu birahmatihi man yashaowallahu thoo alfadli alAAatheem
verses.latinId: Yakhtaṣṣu biraḥmatihī may yasyā'(u), wallāhu żul-faḍlil-‘aẓīm(i).

verses.arabic: ۞ وَمِنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ مَنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِقِنطَارٍ يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّنْ إِن تَأْمَنْهُ بِدِينَارٍ لَّا يُؤَدِّهِۦٓ إِلَيْكَ إِلَّا مَا دُمْتَ عَلَيْهِ قَآئِمًا ۗ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ قَالُوا۟ لَيْسَ عَلَيْنَا فِى ٱلْأُمِّيِّـۧنَ سَبِيلٌ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wamin ahli alkitabi man in ta/manhubiqintarin yu-addihi ilayka waminhum man in ta/manhubideenarin la yu-addihi ilayka illa madumta AAalayhi qa-iman thalika bi-annahum qaloolaysa AAalayna fee al-ommiyyeena sabeelun wayaqooloonaAAala Allahi alkathiba wahum yaAAlamoon
verses.latinId: Wa min ahlil-kitābi man in ta'manhu bi qinṭārin yu'addīhi ilaik(a), wa minhum man in ta'manhu bidīnāril lā yu'addīhi ilaika illā mā dumta ‘alaihi qā'imā(n), żālika bi'annahum qālū laisa ‘alainā fil-ummiyyīna sabīl(un), wa yaqūlūna ‘alallāhil-każiba wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰ مَنْ أَوْفَىٰ بِعَهْدِهِۦ وَٱتَّقَىٰ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.latinEn: Bala man awfa biAAahdihi wattaqafa-inna Allaha yuhibbu almuttaqeen
verses.latinId: Balā man aufā bi‘ahdihī wattaqā fa innallāha yuḥibbul-muttaqīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَشْتَرُونَ بِعَهْدِ ٱللَّهِ وَأَيْمَـٰنِهِمْ ثَمَنًا قَلِيلًا أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَا خَلَـٰقَ لَهُمْ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَلَا يُكَلِّمُهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَا يَنظُرُ إِلَيْهِمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وَلَا يُزَكِّيهِمْ وَلَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena yashtaroona biAAahdiAllahi waaymanihim thamanan qaleelan ola-ikala khalaqa lahum fee al-akhirati walayukallimuhumu Allahu wala yanthuruilayhim yawma alqiyamati wala yuzakkeehim walahumAAathabun aleem
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna yasytarūna bi‘ahdillāhi wa aimānihim ṡamanan qalīlan ulā'ika lā khalāqa lahum fil-ākhirati wa lā yukallimuhumullāhu wa lā yanẓuru ilaihim yaumal-qiyāmati wa lā yuzakkīhim, wa lahum ‘ażābun alīm(un).

verses.arabic: وَإِنَّ مِنْهُمْ لَفَرِيقًا يَلْوُۥنَ أَلْسِنَتَهُم بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِتَحْسَبُوهُ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ وَيَقُولُونَ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقُولُونَ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wa-inna minhum lafareeqan yalwoonaalsinatahum bilkitabi litahsaboohu minaalkitabi wama huwa mina alkitabiwayaqooloona huwa min AAindi Allahi wama huwa minAAindi Allahi wayaqooloona AAala Allahi alkathibawahum yaAAlamoon
verses.latinId: Wa inna minhum lafarīqay yalwūna alsinatahum bil-kitābi litaḥsabūhu minal-kitābi wa mā huwa minal-kitāb(i), wa yaqūlūna huwa min ‘indillāhi wa mā huwa min ‘indillāh(i), wa yaqūlūna ‘alallāhil-każiba wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).

verses.arabic: مَا كَانَ لِبَشَرٍ أَن يُؤْتِيَهُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحُكْمَ وَٱلنُّبُوَّةَ ثُمَّ يَقُولَ لِلنَّاسِ كُونُوا۟ عِبَادًا لِّى مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَـٰكِن كُونُوا۟ رَبَّـٰنِيِّـۧنَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تُعَلِّمُونَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَدْرُسُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ma kana libasharin anyu/tiyahu Allahu alkitaba walhukmawannubuwwata thumma yaqoola linnasikoonoo AAibadan lee min dooni Allahi walakinkoonoo rabbaniyyeena bima kuntum tuAAallimoonaalkitaba wabima kuntum tadrusoon
verses.latinId: Mā kāna libasyarin ay yu'tiyahullāhul-kitāba wal-ḥukma wan-nubuwwata ṡumma yaqūla lin-nāsi kūnū ‘ibādal lī min dūnillāhi wa lākin kūnū rabbāniyyīna bimā kuntum tu‘allimūnal-kitāba  wa bimā kuntum tadrusūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَا يَأْمُرَكُمْ أَن تَتَّخِذُوا۟ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةَ وَٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ أَرْبَابًا ۗ أَيَأْمُرُكُم بِٱلْكُفْرِ بَعْدَ إِذْ أَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wala ya/murakum an tattakhithooalmala-ikata wannabiyyeena arbabanaya/murukum bilkufri baAAda ith antum muslimoon
verses.latinId: Wa lā ya'murakum an tattakhiżul-malā'ikata wan-nabiyyīna arbābā(n), aya'murukum bil-kufri ba‘da iż antum muslimūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ أَخَذَ ٱللَّهُ مِيثَـٰقَ ٱلنَّبِيِّـۧنَ لَمَآ ءَاتَيْتُكُم مِّن كِتَـٰبٍ وَحِكْمَةٍ ثُمَّ جَآءَكُمْ رَسُولٌ مُّصَدِّقٌ لِّمَا مَعَكُمْ لَتُؤْمِنُنَّ بِهِۦ وَلَتَنصُرُنَّهُۥ ۚ قَالَ ءَأَقْرَرْتُمْ وَأَخَذْتُمْ عَلَىٰ ذَٰلِكُمْ إِصْرِى ۖ قَالُوٓا۟ أَقْرَرْنَا ۚ قَالَ فَٱشْهَدُوا۟ وَأَنَا۠ مَعَكُم مِّنَ ٱلشَّـٰهِدِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wa-ith akhatha Allahumeethaqa annabiyyeena lama ataytukummin kitabin wahikmatin thumma jaakumrasoolun musaddiqun lima maAAakum latu/minunna bihiwalatansurunnahu qala aaqrartum waakhathtumAAala thalikum isree qaloo aqrarnaqala fashhadoo waana maAAakum mina ashshahideen
verses.latinId: Wa iż akhażallāhu mīṡāqan-nabiyyīna lamā ātaitukum min kitābiw wa ḥikmatin ṡumma jā'akum rasūlum muṣaddiqul limā ma‘akum latu'minunna bihī wa latanṣurunnah(ū), qāla a'aqrartum wa akhażtum ‘alā żālikum iṣrī, qālū aqrarnā, qāla fasyhadū wa ana ma‘akum minasy-syāhidīn(a).

verses.arabic: فَمَن تَوَلَّىٰ بَعْدَ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.latinEn: Faman tawalla baAAda thalikafaola-ika humu alfasiqoon
verses.latinId: Faman tawallā ba‘da żālika fa ulā'ika humul-fāsiqūn(a).

verses.arabic: أَفَغَيْرَ دِينِ ٱللَّهِ يَبْغُونَ وَلَهُۥٓ أَسْلَمَ مَن فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ طَوْعًا وَكَرْهًا وَإِلَيْهِ يُرْجَعُونَ
verses.latinEn: Afaghayra deeni Allahi yabghoonawalahu aslama man fee assamawati wal-arditawAAan wakarhan wa-ilayhi yurjaAAoon
verses.latinId: Afagaira dīnillāhi yabgūna wa lahū aslama man fis-samāwāti wal-arḍi ṭau‘aw wa ilaihi yurja‘ūn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلْ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَيْنَا وَمَآ أُنزِلَ عَلَىٰٓ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ وَإِسْمَـٰعِيلَ وَإِسْحَـٰقَ وَيَعْقُوبَ وَٱلْأَسْبَاطِ وَمَآ أُوتِىَ مُوسَىٰ وَعِيسَىٰ وَٱلنَّبِيُّونَ مِن رَّبِّهِمْ لَا نُفَرِّقُ بَيْنَ أَحَدٍ مِّنْهُمْ وَنَحْنُ لَهُۥ مُسْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Qul amanna billahiwama onzila AAalayna wama onzila AAalaibraheema wa-ismaAAeela wa-ishaqawayaAAqooba wal-asbati wama ootiya moosawaAAeesa wannabiyyoona min rabbihim lanufarriqu bayna ahadin minhum wanahnu lahumuslimoon
verses.latinId: Qul āmannā billāhi wa mā unzila ‘alainā wa mā unzila ‘alā ibrāhīma wa ismā‘īla wa isḥāqa wa ya‘qūba wal-asbāṭi wa mā ūtiya mūsā wa ‘īsā wan-nabiyyūna mir rabbihim, lā nufarriqu baina aḥadim minhum, wa naḥnu lahū muslimūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَبْتَغِ غَيْرَ ٱلْإِسْلَـٰمِ دِينًا فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْهُ وَهُوَ فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Waman yabtaghi ghayra al-islamideenan falan yuqbala minhu wahuwa fee al-akhirati minaalkhasireen
verses.latinId: Wa may yabtagi gairal-islāmi dīnan  falay yuqbala minh(u), wa huwa fil-ākhirati minal khāsirīn(a).

verses.arabic: كَيْفَ يَهْدِى ٱللَّهُ قَوْمًا كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ وَشَهِدُوٓا۟ أَنَّ ٱلرَّسُولَ حَقٌّ وَجَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يَهْدِى ٱلْقَوْمَ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Kayfa yahdee Allahu qawman kafaroobaAAda eemanihim washahidoo anna arrasoola haqqunwajaahumu albayyinatu wallahu layahdee alqawma aththalimeen
verses.latinId: Kaifa yahdillāhu qauman kafarū ba‘da īmānihim wa syahidū annar-rasūla ḥaqquw wa jā'ahumul-bayyināt(u), wallāhu lā yahdil-qaumaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُمْ أَنَّ عَلَيْهِمْ لَعْنَةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ وَٱلنَّاسِ أَجْمَعِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ola-ika jazaohum annaAAalayhim laAAnata Allahi walmala-ikati wannasiajmaAAeen
verses.latinId: Ulā'ika jazā'uhum anna ‘alaihim la‘natallāhi wal-malā'ikati wan-nāsi ajma‘īn(a).

verses.arabic: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا لَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنْهُمُ ٱلْعَذَابُ وَلَا هُمْ يُنظَرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Khalideena feeha layukhaffafu AAanhumu alAAathabu wala hum yuntharoon
verses.latinId: Khālidīna fihā, lā yukhaffafu ‘anhumul-‘ażābu wa lā hum yunẓarūn(a).

verses.arabic: إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ وَأَصْلَحُوا۟ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Illa allatheena taboomin baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fa-inna Allahaghafoorun raheem
verses.latinId: Illal-lażīna tābū mim ba‘di żālika wa aṣlaḥū, fa'innallāha gafūrur raḥīm(un).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِهِمْ ثُمَّ ٱزْدَادُوا۟ كُفْرًا لَّن تُقْبَلَ تَوْبَتُهُمْ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلضَّآلُّونَ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena kafaroo baAAda eemanihimthumma izdadoo kufran lan tuqbala tawbatuhum waola-ikahumu addalloon
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna kafarū ba‘da īmānihim ṡummazdādū kufral lan tuqbala taubatuhum, wa ulā'ika humuḍ-ḍāllūn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَمَاتُوا۟ وَهُمْ كُفَّارٌ فَلَن يُقْبَلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِم مِّلْءُ ٱلْأَرْضِ ذَهَبًا وَلَوِ ٱفْتَدَىٰ بِهِۦٓ ۗ أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ أَلِيمٌ وَمَا لَهُم مِّن نَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena kafaroo wamatoowahum kuffarun falan yuqbala min ahadihim miloal-ardi thahaban walawi iftada bihi ola-ikalahum AAathabun aleemun wama lahum min nasireen
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna kafarū wa mātū wa hum kuffārun falay yuqbala min aḥadihim mil'ul-arḍi żahabaw wa lawiftadā bih(ī), ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun alīmuw wa mā lahum min nāṣirīn(a).

verses.arabic: لَن تَنَالُوا۟ ٱلْبِرَّ حَتَّىٰ تُنفِقُوا۟ مِمَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ وَمَا تُنفِقُوا۟ مِن شَىْءٍ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِهِۦ عَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Lan tanaloo albirra hattatunfiqoo mimma tuhibboona wama tunfiqoo minshay-in fa-inna Allaha bihi AAaleem
verses.latinId: Lan tanālul-birra ḥattā tunfiqū mimmā tuḥibbūn(a), wa mā tunfiqū min syai'in fa innallāha bihī ‘alīm(un).

verses.arabic: ۞ كُلُّ ٱلطَّعَامِ كَانَ حِلًّا لِّبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ إِلَّا مَا حَرَّمَ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلُ عَلَىٰ نَفْسِهِۦ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تُنَزَّلَ ٱلتَّوْرَىٰةُ ۗ قُلْ فَأْتُوا۟ بِٱلتَّوْرَىٰةِ فَٱتْلُوهَآ إِن كُنتُمْ صَـٰدِقِينَ
verses.latinEn: Kullu attaAAami kanahillan libanee isra-eela illa ma harramaisra-eelu AAala nafsihi min qabli an tunazzala attawratuqul fa/too bittawrati fatlooha inkuntum sadiqeen
verses.latinId: Kulluṭ-ṭa‘āmi kāna ḥillal libanī isrā'īla illā mā ḥarrama isrā'īlu ‘alā nafsihī min qabli an tunazzalat-taurāh(tu), qul fa'tū bit-taurāti fatlūhā in kuntum ṣādiqīn(a).

verses.arabic: فَمَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ٱلْكَذِبَ مِنۢ بَعْدِ ذَٰلِكَ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلظَّـٰلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Famani iftara AAala Allahialkathiba min baAAdi thalika faola-ika humuathalimoon
verses.latinId: Fa maniftarā ‘alallāhil-każiba mim ba‘di żālika fa ulā'ika humuẓ-ẓālimūn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلْ صَدَقَ ٱللَّهُ ۗ فَٱتَّبِعُوا۟ مِلَّةَ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ حَنِيفًا وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ ٱلْمُشْرِكِينَ
verses.latinEn: Qul sadaqa Allahu fattabiAAoomillata ibraheema haneefan wama kanamina almushrikeen
verses.latinId: Qul ṣadaqallāh(u), fattabi‘ū millata ibrāhīma ḥanīfā(n), wa mā kāna minal-musyrikīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ أَوَّلَ بَيْتٍ وُضِعَ لِلنَّاسِ لَلَّذِى بِبَكَّةَ مُبَارَكًا وَهُدًى لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Inna awwala baytin wudiAAa linnasilallathee bibakkata mubarakan wahudan lilAAalameen
verses.latinId: Inna awwala baitiw wuḍi‘a lin-nāsi lal-lażī bibakkata mubārakaw wa hudal lil-‘ālamīn(a).

verses.arabic: فِيهِ ءَايَـٰتٌۢ بَيِّنَـٰتٌ مَّقَامُ إِبْرَٰهِيمَ ۖ وَمَن دَخَلَهُۥ كَانَ ءَامِنًا ۗ وَلِلَّهِ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ حِجُّ ٱلْبَيْتِ مَنِ ٱسْتَطَاعَ إِلَيْهِ سَبِيلًا ۚ وَمَن كَفَرَ فَإِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَنِىٌّ عَنِ ٱلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Feehi ayatun bayyinatunmaqamu ibraheema waman dakhalahu kana aminanwalillahi AAala annasi hijjualbayti mani istataAAa ilayhi sabeelan waman kafarafa-inna Allaha ghaniyyun AAani alAAalameen
verses.latinId: Fīhi āyātum bayyinātum maqāmu ibrāhīm(a), wa man dakhalahū kāna āminā(n), wa lillāhi ‘alan-nāsi ḥijjul-baiti manistaṭā‘a ilaihi sabīlā(n), wa man kafara fa innallāha ganiyyun ‘anil-‘ālamīn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱللَّهُ شَهِيدٌ عَلَىٰ مَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Qul ya ahla alkitabi limatakfuroona bi-ayati Allahi wallahushaheedun AAala ma taAAmaloon
verses.latinId: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima takfurūna bi'āyātillāh(i), wallāhu syahīdun ‘alā mā ta‘malūn(a).

verses.arabic: قُلْ يَـٰٓأَهْلَ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لِمَ تَصُدُّونَ عَن سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ مَنْ ءَامَنَ تَبْغُونَهَا عِوَجًا وَأَنتُمْ شُهَدَآءُ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ بِغَـٰفِلٍ عَمَّا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Qul ya ahla alkitabi lima tasuddoonaAAan sabeeli Allahi man amana tabghoonahaAAiwajan waantum shuhadao wama Allahu bighafilinAAamma taAAmaloon
verses.latinId: Qul yā ahlal-kitābi lima taṣuddūna ‘an sabīlillāhi man āmana tabgūnahā ‘iwajaw wa antum syuhadā'(u), wa mallāhu bigāfilin ‘ammā ta‘malūn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ فَرِيقًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ أُوتُوا۟ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ يَرُدُّوكُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ كَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanooin tuteeAAoo fareeqan mina allatheena ootoo alkitabayaruddookum baAAda eemanikum kafireen
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū in tuṭī‘ū farīqam minal-lażīna ūtul-kitāba yaruddūkum ba‘da īmānikum kāfirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَكَيْفَ تَكْفُرُونَ وَأَنتُمْ تُتْلَىٰ عَلَيْكُمْ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ وَفِيكُمْ رَسُولُهُۥ ۗ وَمَن يَعْتَصِم بِٱللَّهِ فَقَدْ هُدِىَ إِلَىٰ صِرَٰطٍ مُّسْتَقِيمٍ
verses.latinEn: Wakayfa takfuroona waantum tutlaAAalaykum ayatu Allahi wafeekum rasooluhuwaman yaAAtasim billahi faqad hudiya ilasiratin mustaqeem
verses.latinId: Wa kaifa takfurūna wa antum tutlā ‘alaikum āyātullāhi wa fīkum rasūluh(ū), wa may ya‘taṣim billāhi faqad hudiya ilā ṣirāṭim mustaqīm(in).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ ٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ حَقَّ تُقَاتِهِۦ وَلَا تَمُوتُنَّ إِلَّا وَأَنتُم مُّسْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanooittaqoo Allaha haqqa tuqatihi walatamootunna illa waantum muslimoon
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanuttaqullāha ḥaqqa tuqātihī wa lā tamūtunna illā wa antum muslimūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَٱعْتَصِمُوا۟ بِحَبْلِ ٱللَّهِ جَمِيعًا وَلَا تَفَرَّقُوا۟ ۚ وَٱذْكُرُوا۟ نِعْمَتَ ٱللَّهِ عَلَيْكُمْ إِذْ كُنتُمْ أَعْدَآءً فَأَلَّفَ بَيْنَ قُلُوبِكُمْ فَأَصْبَحْتُم بِنِعْمَتِهِۦٓ إِخْوَٰنًا وَكُنتُمْ عَلَىٰ شَفَا حُفْرَةٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ فَأَنقَذَكُم مِّنْهَا ۗ كَذَٰلِكَ يُبَيِّنُ ٱللَّهُ لَكُمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَهْتَدُونَ
verses.latinEn: WaAAtasimoo bihabliAllahi jameeAAan wala tafarraqoo wathkurooniAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith kuntum aAAdaanfaallafa bayna quloobikum faasbahtum biniAAmatihiikhwanan wakuntum AAala shafa hufratinmina annari faanqathakum minha kathalikayubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi laAAallakumtahtadoon
verses.latinId: Wa‘taṣimū biḥablillāhi jamī‘aw wa lā tafarraqū, ważkurū ni‘matallāhi ‘alaikum iż kuntum a‘dā'an fa allafa baina qulūbikum fa aṣbaḥtum bi ni‘matihī ikhwānā(n), wa kuntum ‘alā syafā ḥufratim minan-nāri fa anqażakum minhā, każālika yubayyinullāhu lakum āyātihī la‘allakum tahtadūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلْتَكُن مِّنكُمْ أُمَّةٌ يَدْعُونَ إِلَى ٱلْخَيْرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْمُفْلِحُونَ
verses.latinEn: Waltakun minkum ommatun yadAAoona ilaalkhayri waya/muroona bilmaAAroofi wayanhawna AAanialmunkari waola-ika humu almuflihoon
verses.latinId: Waltakum minkum ummatuy yad‘ūna ilal-khairi wa ya'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa yanhauna ‘anil-munkar(i), wa ulā'ika humul-mufliḥūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ تَفَرَّقُوا۟ وَٱخْتَلَفُوا۟ مِنۢ بَعْدِ مَا جَآءَهُمُ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتُ ۚ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمْ عَذَابٌ عَظِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Wala takoonoo kallatheenatafarraqoo wakhtalafoo min baAAdi ma jaahumualbayyinatu waola-ika lahum AAathabun AAatheem
verses.latinId: Wa lā takūnū kal-lażīna tafarraqū wakhtalafū mim ba‘di mā jā'ahumul-bayyināt(u), wa ulā'ika lahum ‘ażābun ‘aẓīm(un).

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ تَبْيَضُّ وُجُوهٌ وَتَسْوَدُّ وُجُوهٌ ۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْوَدَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ أَكَفَرْتُم بَعْدَ إِيمَـٰنِكُمْ فَذُوقُوا۟ ٱلْعَذَابَ بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَكْفُرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Yawma tabyaddu wujoohun wataswadduwujoohun faamma allatheena iswaddat wujoohuhumakafartum baAAda eemanikum fathooqoo alAAathababima kuntum takfuroon
verses.latinId: Yauma tabyaḍḍu wujūhuw wa taswaddu wujūh(un), fa ammal-lażīnaswaddat wujūhuhum, akafartum ba‘da īmānikum fa żūqul-‘ażāba bimā kuntum takfurūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ٱبْيَضَّتْ وُجُوهُهُمْ فَفِى رَحْمَةِ ٱللَّهِ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.latinEn: Waamma allatheena ibyaddatwujoohuhum fafee rahmati Allahi hum feeha khalidoon
verses.latinId: Wa ammal lażīnabyaḍḍat wujūhuhum fafī raḥmatillāh(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).

verses.arabic: تِلْكَ ءَايَـٰتُ ٱللَّهِ نَتْلُوهَا عَلَيْكَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۗ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعَـٰلَمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Tilka ayatu Allahinatlooha AAalayka bilhaqqi wama Allahuyureedu thulman lilAAalameen
verses.latinId: Tilka āyātullāhi natlūhā ‘alaika bil-ḥaqq(i), wa mallāhu yurīdu ẓulmal lil-‘ālamīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ وَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُرْجَعُ ٱلْأُمُورُ
verses.latinEn: Walillahi ma fee assamawatiwama fee al-ardi wa-ila AllahiturjaAAu al-omoor
verses.latinId: Wa lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), wa ilallāhi turja‘ul-umūr(u).

verses.arabic: كُنتُمْ خَيْرَ أُمَّةٍ أُخْرِجَتْ لِلنَّاسِ تَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَتَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ ۗ وَلَوْ ءَامَنَ أَهْلُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ لَكَانَ خَيْرًا لَّهُم ۚ مِّنْهُمُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ وَأَكْثَرُهُمُ ٱلْفَـٰسِقُونَ
verses.latinEn: Kuntum khayra ommatin okhrijat linnasita/muroona bilmaAAroofi watanhawna AAani almunkariwatu/minoona billahi walaw amana ahlu alkitabilakana khayran lahum minhumu almu/minoona waaktharuhumualfasiqoon
verses.latinId: Kuntum khaira ummatin ukhrijat lin-nāsi ta'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa tanhauna ‘anil-munkari wa tu'minūna billāh(i), wa lau āmana ahlul-kitābi lakāna khairal lahum, minhumul-mu'minūna wa akṡaruhumul-fāsiqūn(a).

verses.arabic: لَن يَضُرُّوكُمْ إِلَّآ أَذًى ۖ وَإِن يُقَـٰتِلُوكُمْ يُوَلُّوكُمُ ٱلْأَدْبَارَ ثُمَّ لَا يُنصَرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Lan yadurrookum illa athanwa-in yuqatilookum yuwallookumu al-adbara thumma layunsaroon
verses.latinId: Lay yaḍurrūkum illā ażā(n), wa iy yuqātilūkum yuwallūkumul-adbār(a), ṡumma lā yunṣarūn(a).

verses.arabic: ضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلذِّلَّةُ أَيْنَ مَا ثُقِفُوٓا۟ إِلَّا بِحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَحَبْلٍ مِّنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَبَآءُو بِغَضَبٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَضُرِبَتْ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْمَسْكَنَةُ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانُوا۟ يَكْفُرُونَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ وَيَقْتُلُونَ ٱلْأَنۢبِيَآءَ بِغَيْرِ حَقٍّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِمَا عَصَوا۟ وَّكَانُوا۟ يَعْتَدُونَ
verses.latinEn: Duribat AAalayhimu aththillatuayna ma thuqifoo illa bihablin mina Allahiwahablin mina annasi wabaoo bighadabinmina Allahi waduribat AAalayhimu almaskanatu thalikabi-annahum kanoo yakfuroona bi-ayati Allahiwayaqtuloona al-anbiyaa bighayri haqqin thalikabima AAasaw wakanoo yaAAtadoon
verses.latinId: Ḍuribat ‘alaihimuż-żillatu aina mā ṡuqifū illā biḥablim minallāhi wa ḥablim minan-nāsi wa bā'ū bigaḍabim minallāhi wa ḍuribat ‘alaihimul-maskanah(tu), żālika bi'annahum kānū yakfurūna bi'āyātillāhi wa yaqtulūnal-ambiyā'a bigairi ḥaqq(in), żālika bimā ‘aṣaw wa kānū ya‘tadūn(a).

verses.arabic: ۞ لَيْسُوا۟ سَوَآءً ۗ مِّنْ أَهْلِ ٱلْكِتَـٰبِ أُمَّةٌ قَآئِمَةٌ يَتْلُونَ ءَايَـٰتِ ٱللَّهِ ءَانَآءَ ٱلَّيْلِ وَهُمْ يَسْجُدُونَ
verses.latinEn: Laysoo sawaan min ahli alkitabiommatun qa-imatun yatloona ayati Allahianaa allayli wahum yasjudoon
verses.latinId: Laisū sawā'ā(n), min ahlil-kitābi ummatun qā'imatuy yatlūna āyātillāhi ānā'al-laili wa hum yasjudūn(a).

verses.arabic: يُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱللَّهِ وَٱلْيَوْمِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرِ وَيَأْمُرُونَ بِٱلْمَعْرُوفِ وَيَنْهَوْنَ عَنِ ٱلْمُنكَرِ وَيُسَـٰرِعُونَ فِى ٱلْخَيْرَٰتِ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحِينَ
verses.latinEn: Yu/minoona billahi walyawmial-akhiri waya/muroona bilmaAAroofi wayanhawnaAAani almunkari wayusariAAoona fee alkhayrati waola-ikamina assaliheen
verses.latinId: Yu'minūna billāhi wal-yaumil-ākhiri wa ya'murūna bil-ma‘rūfi wa yanhauna ‘anil-munkari wa yusāri‘ūna fil-khairāt(i), wa ulā'ika minaṣ-ṣāliḥīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا يَفْعَلُوا۟ مِنْ خَيْرٍ فَلَن يُكْفَرُوهُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wama yafAAaloo min khayrin falanyukfaroohu wallahu AAaleemun bilmuttaqeen
verses.latinId: Wa mā yaf‘alūna min khairin falay yukfarūh(u), wallāhu ‘alīmum bil-muttaqīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ لَن تُغْنِىَ عَنْهُمْ أَمْوَٰلُهُمْ وَلَآ أَوْلَـٰدُهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ شَيْـًٔا ۖ وَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ ۚ هُمْ فِيهَا خَـٰلِدُونَ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena kafaroo lan tughniyaAAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahishay-an waola-ika as-habu annarihum feeha khalidoon
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna kafarū lan tugniya ‘anhum amwāluhum wa lā aulāduhum minallāhi syai'ā(n), wa ulā'ika aṣḥābun-nār(i), hum fīhā khālidūn(a).

verses.arabic: مَثَلُ مَا يُنفِقُونَ فِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا كَمَثَلِ رِيحٍ فِيهَا صِرٌّ أَصَابَتْ حَرْثَ قَوْمٍ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ فَأَهْلَكَتْهُ ۚ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَلَـٰكِنْ أَنفُسَهُمْ يَظْلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Mathalu ma yunfiqoona fee hathihialhayati addunya kamathali reehinfeeha sirrun asabat hartha qawmin thalamooanfusahum faahlakat-hu wama thalamahumu Allahuwalakin anfusahum yathlimoon
verses.latinId: Maṡalu mā yunfiqūna fī hāżihil-ḥayātid-dun-yā kamaṡali rīḥin fihā ṣirrun aṣābat ḥarṡa qaumin ẓalamū anfusahum fa ahlakath(u), wa mā ẓalamahumullāhu wa lākin anfusahum yaẓlimūn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَتَّخِذُوا۟ بِطَانَةً مِّن دُونِكُمْ لَا يَأْلُونَكُمْ خَبَالًا وَدُّوا۟ مَا عَنِتُّمْ قَدْ بَدَتِ ٱلْبَغْضَآءُ مِنْ أَفْوَٰهِهِمْ وَمَا تُخْفِى صُدُورُهُمْ أَكْبَرُ ۚ قَدْ بَيَّنَّا لَكُمُ ٱلْـَٔايَـٰتِ ۖ إِن كُنتُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoola tattakhithoo bitanatan min doonikum laya/loonakum khabalan waddoo ma AAanittum qad badatialbaghdao min afwahihim wama tukhfee sudooruhumakbaru qad bayyanna lakumu al-ayati inkuntum taAAqiloon
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā tattakhiżū biṭānatam min dūnikum lā ya'lūnakum khabālā(n), waddū mā ‘anittum, qad badatil-bagḍā'u min afwāhihim, wa mā tukhfī ṣudūruhum akbar(u), qad bayyannā lakumul-āyāti in kuntum ta‘qilūn(a).

verses.arabic: هَـٰٓأَنتُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ تُحِبُّونَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِبُّونَكُمْ وَتُؤْمِنُونَ بِٱلْكِتَـٰبِ كُلِّهِۦ وَإِذَا لَقُوكُمْ قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا وَإِذَا خَلَوْا۟ عَضُّوا۟ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْأَنَامِلَ مِنَ ٱلْغَيْظِ ۚ قُلْ مُوتُوا۟ بِغَيْظِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.latinEn: Ha antum ola-i tuhibboonahumwala yuhibboonakum watu/minoona bilkitabikullihi wa-itha laqookum qaloo amannawa-itha khalaw AAaddoo AAalaykumu al-anamilamina alghaythi qul mootoo bighaythikuminna Allaha AAaleemun bithati assudoor
verses.latinId: Hā antum ulā'i tuḥibbūnahum wa lā yuḥibbūnakum wa tu'minūna bil-kitābi kullih(ī), wa iżā laqūkum qālū āmannā, wa iżā khalau ‘aḍḍū ‘alaikumul-anāmila  minal-gaiẓ(i), qul mūtū bigaiẓikum, innallāha ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).

verses.arabic: إِن تَمْسَسْكُمْ حَسَنَةٌ تَسُؤْهُمْ وَإِن تُصِبْكُمْ سَيِّئَةٌ يَفْرَحُوا۟ بِهَا ۖ وَإِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ لَا يَضُرُّكُمْ كَيْدُهُمْ شَيْـًٔا ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ مُحِيطٌ
verses.latinEn: In tamsaskum hasanatun tasu/humwa-in tusibkum sayyi-atun yafrahoo bihawa-in tasbiroo watattaqoo la yadurrukumkayduhum shay-an inna Allaha bima yaAAmaloona muheet
verses.latinId: In tamsaskum ḥasanatun tasu'hum, wa in tuṣibkum sayyi'atuy yafraḥū bihā, wa in taṣbirū wa tattaqū lā yaḍurrukum kaiduhum syai'ā(n), innallāha bimā ya‘malūna muḥīṭ(un).

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ غَدَوْتَ مِنْ أَهْلِكَ تُبَوِّئُ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ مَقَـٰعِدَ لِلْقِتَالِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ سَمِيعٌ عَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Wa-ith ghadawta min ahlika tubawwi-oalmu/mineena maqaAAida lilqitali wallahusameeAAun AAaleem
verses.latinId: Wa iż gadauka min ahlika tubawwi'ul-mu'minīna maqā‘ida lil-qitāl(i), wallāhu samī‘un ‘alīm(un).

verses.arabic: إِذْ هَمَّت طَّآئِفَتَانِ مِنكُمْ أَن تَفْشَلَا وَٱللَّهُ وَلِيُّهُمَا ۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ith hammat ta-ifataniminkum an tafshala wallahu waliyyuhumawaAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almu/minoon
verses.latinId: Iż hammat-ṭā'ifatāni minkum an tafsyalā, wallāhu waliyyuhumā, wa ‘alallāhi falyatawakkalil-mu'minūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ نَصَرَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِبَدْرٍ وَأَنتُمْ أَذِلَّةٌ ۖ فَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تَشْكُرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Walaqad nasarakumu Allahubibadrin waantum athillatun fattaqoo AllahalaAAallakum tashkuroon
verses.latinId: Wa laqad naṣarakumullāhu bibadriw wa antum ażillah(tun), fattaqullāha la‘allakum tasykurūn(a).

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَقُولُ لِلْمُؤْمِنِينَ أَلَن يَكْفِيَكُمْ أَن يُمِدَّكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِثَلَـٰثَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُنزَلِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ith taqoolu lilmu/mineena alanyakfiyakum an yumiddakum rabbukum bithalathati alafinmina almala-ikati munzaleen
verses.latinId: Iż taqūlu lil-mu'minīna alay yakfiyakum ay yumiddakum rabbukum biṡalāṡati ālāfim minal-malā'ikati munzalīn(a).

verses.arabic: بَلَىٰٓ ۚ إِن تَصْبِرُوا۟ وَتَتَّقُوا۟ وَيَأْتُوكُم مِّن فَوْرِهِمْ هَـٰذَا يُمْدِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُم بِخَمْسَةِ ءَالَـٰفٍ مِّنَ ٱلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ مُسَوِّمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Bala in tasbiroo watattaqoowaya/tookum min fawrihim hatha yumdidkum rabbukumbikhamsati alafin mina almala-ikatimusawwimeen
verses.latinId: Balā, in taṣbirū wa tattaqū wa ya'tūkum min faurihim hāżā yumdidkum rabbukum bikhamsati ālāfim minal-malā'ikati musawwimīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا جَعَلَهُ ٱللَّهُ إِلَّا بُشْرَىٰ لَكُمْ وَلِتَطْمَئِنَّ قُلُوبُكُم بِهِۦ ۗ وَمَا ٱلنَّصْرُ إِلَّا مِنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَكِيمِ
verses.latinEn: Wama jaAAalahu Allahu illabushra lakum walitatma-inna quloobukum bihi wamaannasru illa min AAindi AllahialAAazeezi alhakeem
verses.latinId: Wa mā ja‘alahullāhu illā busyrā lakum wa litaṭma'inna qulūbukum bih(ī), wa man-naṣru illā min ‘indillāhil-‘azīzil-ḥakīm(i).

verses.arabic: لِيَقْطَعَ طَرَفًا مِّنَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَوْ يَكْبِتَهُمْ فَيَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَآئِبِينَ
verses.latinEn: LiyaqtaAAa tarafan mina allatheenakafaroo aw yakbitahum fayanqaliboo kha-ibeen
verses.latinId: Liyaqṭa‘a ṭarafam minal-lażīna kafarū au yakbitahum fa yanqalibū khā'ibīn(a).

verses.arabic: لَيْسَ لَكَ مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ أَوْ يَتُوبَ عَلَيْهِمْ أَوْ يُعَذِّبَهُمْ فَإِنَّهُمْ ظَـٰلِمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Laysa laka mina al-amri shay-on aw yatoobaAAalayhim aw yuAAaththibahum fa-innahum thalimoon
verses.latinId: Laisa laka minal-amri syai'un au yatūba ‘alaihim au yu‘ażżibahum fa innahum ẓālimūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلِلَّهِ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ۚ يَغْفِرُ لِمَن يَشَآءُ وَيُعَذِّبُ مَن يَشَآءُ ۚ وَٱللَّهُ غَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Walillahi ma fee assamawatiwama fee al-ardi yaghfiru liman yashaowayuAAaththibu man yashao wallahughafoorun raheem
verses.latinId: Wa lillāhi mā fis-samāwāti wa mā fil-arḍ(i), yagfiru limay yasyā'u wa yu‘ażżibu may yasyā'(u), wallāhu gafūrur raḥīm(un).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَأْكُلُوا۟ ٱلرِّبَوٰٓا۟ أَضْعَـٰفًا مُّضَـٰعَفَةً ۖ وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُفْلِحُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoola ta/kuloo arriba adAAafanmudaAAafatan wattaqoo Allaha laAAallakumtuflihoon
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā ta'kulur-ribā aḍ‘āfam muḍā‘afah(tan), wattaqullāha la‘allakum tufliḥūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَٱتَّقُوا۟ ٱلنَّارَ ٱلَّتِىٓ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wattaqoo annaraallatee oAAiddat lilkafireen
verses.latinId: Wattaqun-nāral latī u‘iddat lil-kāfirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَأَطِيعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ وَٱلرَّسُولَ لَعَلَّكُمْ تُرْحَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: WaateeAAoo Allaha warrasoolalaAAallakum turhamoon
verses.latinId: Wa aṭī‘ullāha war-rasūla la‘allakum turḥamūn(a).

verses.arabic: ۞ وَسَارِعُوٓا۟ إِلَىٰ مَغْفِرَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ وَجَنَّةٍ عَرْضُهَا ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتُ وَٱلْأَرْضُ أُعِدَّتْ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.latinEn: WasariAAoo ila maghfiratinmin rabbikum wajannatin AAarduha assamawatuwal-ardu oAAiddat lilmuttaqeen
verses.latinId: Wa sāri‘ū ilā magfiratim mir rabbikum wa jannatin ‘arḍuhas-samāwātu wal-arḍ(u), u‘iddat lil-muttaqīn(a).

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِينَ يُنفِقُونَ فِى ٱلسَّرَّآءِ وَٱلضَّرَّآءِ وَٱلْكَـٰظِمِينَ ٱلْغَيْظَ وَٱلْعَافِينَ عَنِ ٱلنَّاسِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Allatheena yunfiqoona fee assarra-iwaddarra-i walkathimeenaalghaytha walAAafeena AAani annasiwallahu yuhibbu almuhsineen
verses.latinId: Al-lażīna yunfiqūna fis-sarrā'i waḍ-ḍarrā'i wal-kāẓimīnal gaiẓa wal-‘āfīna ‘anin-nās(i), wallāhu yuḥibbul-muḥsinīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَٱلَّذِينَ إِذَا فَعَلُوا۟ فَـٰحِشَةً أَوْ ظَلَمُوٓا۟ أَنفُسَهُمْ ذَكَرُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ فَٱسْتَغْفَرُوا۟ لِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَن يَغْفِرُ ٱلذُّنُوبَ إِلَّا ٱللَّهُ وَلَمْ يُصِرُّوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَعَلُوا۟ وَهُمْ يَعْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wallatheena ithafaAAaloo fahishatan aw thalamoo anfusahum thakarooAllaha fastaghfaroo lithunoobihim wamanyaghfiru aththunooba illa Allahuwalam yusirroo AAala ma faAAaloo wahumyaAAlamoon
verses.latinId: Wal-lażīna iżā fa‘alū fāḥisyatan au ẓalamū anfusahum żakarullāha fastagfarū liżunūbihim, wa may yagfiruż-żunūba illallāh(u), wa lam yuṣirrū ‘alā mā fa‘alū wa hum ya‘lamūn(a).

verses.arabic: أُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ جَزَآؤُهُم مَّغْفِرَةٌ مِّن رَّبِّهِمْ وَجَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَنِعْمَ أَجْرُ ٱلْعَـٰمِلِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ola-ika jazaohum maghfiratunmin rabbihim wajannatun tajree min tahtihaal-anharu khalideena feeha waniAAma ajrualAAamileen
verses.latinId: Ulā'ika jazā'uhum magfiratum mir rabbihim wa jannātun tajrī min taḥtihal-anhāru khālidīna fīhā, wa ni‘ma ajrul-‘āmilīn(a).

verses.arabic: قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِكُمْ سُنَنٌ فَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَٱنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَـٰقِبَةُ ٱلْمُكَذِّبِينَ
verses.latinEn: Qad khalat min qablikum sunanun faseeroofee al-ardi fanthuroo kayfa kanaAAaqibatu almukaththibeen
verses.latinId: Qad khalat min qablikum sunan(un), fa sīrū fil-arḍi fanẓurū kaifa kāna ‘āqibatul-mukażżibīn(a).

verses.arabic: هَـٰذَا بَيَانٌ لِّلنَّاسِ وَهُدًى وَمَوْعِظَةٌ لِّلْمُتَّقِينَ
verses.latinEn: Hatha bayanun linnasiwahudan wamawAAithatun lilmuttaqeen
verses.latinId: Hāżā bayānul lin-nāsi wa hudaw wa mau‘iẓatul lil-muttaqīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَهِنُوا۟ وَلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ وَأَنتُمُ ٱلْأَعْلَوْنَ إِن كُنتُم مُّؤْمِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wala tahinoo wala tahzanoowaantumu al-aAAlawna in kuntum mu/mineen
verses.latinId: Wa lā tahinū wa lā taḥzanū wa antumul-a‘launa in kuntum mu'minīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِن يَمْسَسْكُمْ قَرْحٌ فَقَدْ مَسَّ ٱلْقَوْمَ قَرْحٌ مِّثْلُهُۥ ۚ وَتِلْكَ ٱلْأَيَّامُ نُدَاوِلُهَا بَيْنَ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَتَّخِذَ مِنكُمْ شُهَدَآءَ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ لَا يُحِبُّ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.latinEn: In yamsaskum qarhun faqad massaalqawma qarhun mithluhu watilka al-ayyamu nudawiluhabayna annasi waliyaAAlama Allahu allatheenaamanoo wayattakhitha minkum shuhadaa wallahula yuhibbu aththalimeen
verses.latinId: Iy yamsaskum qarḥun faqad massal-qauma qarḥum miṡluh(ū), wa tilkal-ayyāmu nudāwiluhā binan-nās(i), wa liya‘lamallāhul-lażīna āmanū wa yattakhiża minkum syuhadā'(u),  wallāhu lā yuḥibbuẓ-ẓālimīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلِيُمَحِّصَ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَيَمْحَقَ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Waliyumahhisa Allahuallatheena amanoo wayamhaqa alkafireen
verses.latinId: Wa liyumaḥḥiṣallāhul-lażīna āmanū wa yamḥaqal-kāfirīn(a).

verses.arabic: أَمْ حَسِبْتُمْ أَن تَدْخُلُوا۟ ٱلْجَنَّةَ وَلَمَّا يَعْلَمِ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِينَ جَـٰهَدُوا۟ مِنكُمْ وَيَعْلَمَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Am hasibtum an tadkhuloo aljannatawalamma yaAAlami Allahu allatheena jahadoominkum wayaAAlama assabireen
verses.latinId: Am ḥasibtum an tadkhulul-jannata wa lammā ya‘lamillāhul-lażīna jāhadū minkum wa ya‘lamaṣ-ṣābirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ كُنتُمْ تَمَنَّوْنَ ٱلْمَوْتَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن تَلْقَوْهُ فَقَدْ رَأَيْتُمُوهُ وَأَنتُمْ تَنظُرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Walaqad kuntum tamannawna almawta min qablian talqawhu faqad raaytumoohu waantum tanthuroon
verses.latinId: Wa laqad kuntum tamannaunal-mauta min qabli an talqauh(u), faqad ra'aitumūhu wa antum tanẓurūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا مُحَمَّدٌ إِلَّا رَسُولٌ قَدْ خَلَتْ مِن قَبْلِهِ ٱلرُّسُلُ ۚ أَفَإِي۟ن مَّاتَ أَوْ قُتِلَ ٱنقَلَبْتُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ ۚ وَمَن يَنقَلِبْ عَلَىٰ عَقِبَيْهِ فَلَن يَضُرَّ ٱللَّهَ شَيْـًٔا ۗ وَسَيَجْزِى ٱللَّهُ ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wama muhammadun illarasoolun qad khalat min qablihi arrusulu afa-in mataaw qutila inqalabtum AAala aAAqabikum wamanyanqalib AAala AAaqibayhi falan yadurra Allahashay-an wasayajzee Allahu ashshakireen
verses.latinId: Wa mā muḥammadun illā rasūl(un), qad khalat min qablihir-rusul(u), afa'im māta au qutilanqalabtum ‘alā a‘qābikum, wa may yanqalib ‘alā ‘aqibaihi falay yaḍurrallāha syai'ā(n), wa sayajzillāhusy-syākirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَفْسٍ أَن تَمُوتَ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ كِتَـٰبًا مُّؤَجَّلًا ۗ وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا وَمَن يُرِدْ ثَوَابَ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ نُؤْتِهِۦ مِنْهَا ۚ وَسَنَجْزِى ٱلشَّـٰكِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wama kana linafsin an tamootailla bi-ithni Allahi kitabanmu-ajjalan waman yurid thawaba addunyanu/tihi minha waman yurid thawaba al-akhiratinu/tihi minha wasanajzee ashshakireen
verses.latinId: Wa mā kāna linafsin an tamūta illā bi'iżnillāhi kitābam mu'ajjalā(n), wa may yurid ṡawābad-dun-yā nu'tihī minhā, wa may yurid ṡawābal-ākhirati nu'tihī minhā, wa sanajzisy-syākirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَكَأَيِّن مِّن نَّبِىٍّ قَـٰتَلَ مَعَهُۥ رِبِّيُّونَ كَثِيرٌ فَمَا وَهَنُوا۟ لِمَآ أَصَابَهُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَمَا ضَعُفُوا۟ وَمَا ٱسْتَكَانُوا۟ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wakaayyin min nabiyyin qatalamaAAahu ribbiyyoona katheerun fama wahanoo lima asabahumfee sabeeli Allahi wama daAAufoo wamaistakanoo wallahu yuhibbu assabireen
verses.latinId: Wa ka'ayyim min nabiyyin qātal(a), ma‘ahū ribbiyyūna kaṡīr(un), famā wahanū limā aṣābahum fī sabīlillāhi wa mā ḍa‘ufū wa mastakānū, wallāhu yuḥibbuṣ-ṣābirīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ قَوْلَهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا ٱغْفِرْ لَنَا ذُنُوبَنَا وَإِسْرَافَنَا فِىٓ أَمْرِنَا وَثَبِّتْ أَقْدَامَنَا وَٱنصُرْنَا عَلَى ٱلْقَوْمِ ٱلْكَـٰفِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wama kana qawlahum illaan qaloo rabbana ighfir lana thunoobanawa-israfana fee amrina wathabbit aqdamanawansurna AAala alqawmi alkafireen
verses.latinId: Wa mā kāna qauluhum illā an qālū rabbanagfir lanā żunūbanā wa isrāfanā fī amrinā wa ṡabbit aqdāmanā wanṣurnā ‘alal-qaumil-kāfirīn(a).

verses.arabic: فَـَٔاتَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ ثَوَابَ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَحُسْنَ ثَوَابِ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُحْسِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Faatahumu Allahu thawabaaddunya wahusna thawabi al-akhiratiwallahu yuhibbu almuhsineen
verses.latinId: Fa ātāhumullāhu ṡawābad-dun-yā wa ḥusna ṡawābil-ākhirah(ti), wallāhu yuḥibbul-muḥsinīn(a).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوٓا۟ إِن تُطِيعُوا۟ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يَرُدُّوكُمْ عَلَىٰٓ أَعْقَـٰبِكُمْ فَتَنقَلِبُوا۟ خَـٰسِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanooin tuteeAAoo allatheena kafaroo yaruddookum AAalaaAAqabikum fatanqaliboo khasireen
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū in tuṭī‘ul-lażīna kafarū yaruddūkum ‘alā a‘qābikum fa tanqalibū khāsirīn(a).

verses.arabic: بَلِ ٱللَّهُ مَوْلَىٰكُمْ ۖ وَهُوَ خَيْرُ ٱلنَّـٰصِرِينَ
verses.latinEn: Bali Allahu mawlakum wahuwakhayru annasireen
verses.latinId: Balillāhu maulākum, wa huwa khairun-nāṣirīn(a).

verses.arabic: سَنُلْقِى فِى قُلُوبِ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ ٱلرُّعْبَ بِمَآ أَشْرَكُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ مَا لَمْ يُنَزِّلْ بِهِۦ سُلْطَـٰنًا ۖ وَمَأْوَىٰهُمُ ٱلنَّارُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verses.latinEn: Sanulqee fee quloobi allatheenakafaroo arruAAba bima ashrakoo billahima lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wama/wahumu annaruwabi/sa mathwa aththalimeen
verses.latinId: Sanulqī fī qulūbil-lażīna kafarur-ru‘ba bimā asyrakū billāhi mā lam yunazzil bihī sulṭānā(n), wa ma'wāhumun nār(u), wa bi'sa maṡwaẓ-ẓālimīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ صَدَقَكُمُ ٱللَّهُ وَعْدَهُۥٓ إِذْ تَحُسُّونَهُم بِإِذْنِهِۦ ۖ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا فَشِلْتُمْ وَتَنَـٰزَعْتُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ وَعَصَيْتُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ مَآ أَرَىٰكُم مَّا تُحِبُّونَ ۚ مِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُرِيدُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ ۚ ثُمَّ صَرَفَكُمْ عَنْهُمْ لِيَبْتَلِيَكُمْ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا عَنكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ ذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Walaqad sadaqakumu AllahuwaAAdahu ith tahussoonahum bi-ithnihi hattaitha fashiltum watanazaAAtum fee al-amri waAAasaytummin baAAdi ma arakum ma tuhibboonaminkum man yureedu addunya waminkum man yureedual-akhirata thumma sarafakum AAanhum liyabtaliyakumwalaqad AAafa AAankum wallahu thoofadlin AAala almu/mineen
verses.latinId: Wa laqad ṣadaqakumullāhu wa‘dahū iż taḥussūnahum bi'iżnih(ī), ḥattā iżā fasyiltum wa tanāza‘tum fil-amri wa ‘aṣaitum mim ba‘di mā arākum mā tuḥibbūn(a), minkum may yurīdud-dun-yā wa minkum may yurīdul-ākhirah(ta), ṡumma ṣarafakum ‘anhum liyabtaliyakum, wa laqad ‘afā ‘ankum, wallāhu żū faḍlin ‘alal-mu'minīn(a).

verses.arabic: ۞ إِذْ تُصْعِدُونَ وَلَا تَلْوُۥنَ عَلَىٰٓ أَحَدٍ وَٱلرَّسُولُ يَدْعُوكُمْ فِىٓ أُخْرَىٰكُمْ فَأَثَـٰبَكُمْ غَمًّۢا بِغَمٍّ لِّكَيْلَا تَحْزَنُوا۟ عَلَىٰ مَا فَاتَكُمْ وَلَا مَآ أَصَـٰبَكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَبِيرٌۢ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Ith tusAAidoona walatalwoona AAala ahadin warrasooluyadAAookum fee okhrakum faathabakum ghammanbighammin likay la tahzanoo AAala mafatakum wala ma asabakum wallahukhabeerun bima taAAmaloon
verses.latinId: Iż tuṣ‘idūna wa lā talwūna ‘alā aḥadiw war-rasūlu yad‘ūkum fī ukhrākum fa aṡābakum gammam bigammil likailā taḥzanū ‘alā mā fātakum wa lā mā aṣābakum, wallāhu khabīrum bimā ta‘malūn(a).

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ أَنزَلَ عَلَيْكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِ ٱلْغَمِّ أَمَنَةً نُّعَاسًا يَغْشَىٰ طَآئِفَةً مِّنكُمْ ۖ وَطَآئِفَةٌ قَدْ أَهَمَّتْهُمْ أَنفُسُهُمْ يَظُنُّونَ بِٱللَّهِ غَيْرَ ٱلْحَقِّ ظَنَّ ٱلْجَـٰهِلِيَّةِ ۖ يَقُولُونَ هَل لَّنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ مِن شَىْءٍ ۗ قُلْ إِنَّ ٱلْأَمْرَ كُلَّهُۥ لِلَّهِ ۗ يُخْفُونَ فِىٓ أَنفُسِهِم مَّا لَا يُبْدُونَ لَكَ ۖ يَقُولُونَ لَوْ كَانَ لَنَا مِنَ ٱلْأَمْرِ شَىْءٌ مَّا قُتِلْنَا هَـٰهُنَا ۗ قُل لَّوْ كُنتُمْ فِى بُيُوتِكُمْ لَبَرَزَ ٱلَّذِينَ كُتِبَ عَلَيْهِمُ ٱلْقَتْلُ إِلَىٰ مَضَاجِعِهِمْ ۖ وَلِيَبْتَلِىَ ٱللَّهُ مَا فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَلِيُمَحِّصَ مَا فِى قُلُوبِكُمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ عَلِيمٌۢ بِذَاتِ ٱلصُّدُورِ
verses.latinEn: Thumma anzala AAalaykum min baAAdi alghammiamanatan nuAAasan yaghsha ta-ifatan minkumwata-ifatun qad ahammat-hum anfusuhum yathunnoonabillahi ghayra alhaqqi thannaaljahiliyyati yaqooloona hal lana mina al-amri minshay-in qul inna al-amra kullahu lillahi yukhfoona feeanfusihim ma la yubdoona laka yaqooloona law kanalana mina al-amri shay-on ma qutilna hahunaqul law kuntum fee buyootikum labaraza allatheena kutibaAAalayhimu alqatlu ila madajiAAihim waliyabtaliyaAllahu ma fee sudoorikum waliyumahhisama fee quloobikum wallahu AAaleemun bithatiassudoor
verses.latinId: Ṡumma anzala ‘alaikum mim ba‘dil-gammi amanatan nu‘āsay yagsyā ṭā'ifatam minkum, wa ṭā'ifatun qad ahammathum  anfusuhum yaẓunnūna billāhi gairal-ḥaqqi ẓanal-jāhiliyyah(ti), yaqūlūna hal lanā minal-amri min syai'(in), qul innal-amra kullahū lillāh(i), yukhfūna fī anfusihim mā lā yubdūna lak(a), yaqūlūna lau kāna lanā minal-amri syai'um mā qutilnā hāhunā, qul lau kuntum fī buyūtikum labarazal-lażīna kutiba ‘alaihimul-qatlu ilā maḍāji‘ihim, wa liyabtaliyallāhu mā fī ṣudūrikum wa liyumaḥḥiṣa mā fī qulūbikum, wallāhu ‘alīmum biżātiṣ-ṣudūr(i).

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ تَوَلَّوْا۟ مِنكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ إِنَّمَا ٱسْتَزَلَّهُمُ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِبَعْضِ مَا كَسَبُوا۟ ۖ وَلَقَدْ عَفَا ٱللَّهُ عَنْهُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ غَفُورٌ حَلِيمٌ
verses.latinEn: Inna allatheena tawallaw minkumyawma iltaqa aljamAAani innama istazallahumuashshaytanu bibaAAdi ma kasaboowalaqad AAafa Allahu AAanhum inna Allahaghafoorun haleem
verses.latinId: Innal-lażīna tawallau minkum yaumal-taqal-jam‘ān(i), innamastazallahumusy-syaiṭānu biba‘ḍi mā kasabū, wa laqad ‘afallāhu ‘anhum, innallāha gafūrun ḥalīm(un).

verses.arabic: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ لَا تَكُونُوا۟ كَٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ وَقَالُوا۟ لِإِخْوَٰنِهِمْ إِذَا ضَرَبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ أَوْ كَانُوا۟ غُزًّى لَّوْ كَانُوا۟ عِندَنَا مَا مَاتُوا۟ وَمَا قُتِلُوا۟ لِيَجْعَلَ ٱللَّهُ ذَٰلِكَ حَسْرَةً فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بِمَا تَعْمَلُونَ بَصِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoola takoonoo kallatheena kafaroo waqalooli-ikhwanihim itha daraboo fee al-ardiaw kanoo ghuzzan law kanoo AAindana mamatoo wama qutiloo liyajAAala Allahu thalikahasratan fee quloobihim wallahu yuhyeewayumeetu wallahu bima taAAmaloona baseer
verses.latinId: Yā ayyuhal-lażīna āmanū lā takūnū kal-lażīna kafarū wa qālū li'ikhwānihim iżā ḍarabū fil-arḍi au kānū guzzal lau kānū ‘indanā mā mātū wa mā qutilū, liyaj‘alallāhu żālika ḥasratan fī qulūbihim, wallāhu yuḥyī wa yumīt(u), wallāhu  bimā ta‘malūna baṣīr(un).

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن قُتِلْتُمْ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوْ مُتُّمْ لَمَغْفِرَةٌ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَرَحْمَةٌ خَيْرٌ مِّمَّا يَجْمَعُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wala-in qutiltum fee sabeeli Allahiaw muttum lamaghfiratun mina Allahi warahmatunkhayrun mimma yajmaAAoon
verses.latinId: Wa la'in qutiltum fī sabīlillāhi au muttum lamagfiratum minallāhi wa raḥmatun khairum mimmā yajma‘ūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلَئِن مُّتُّمْ أَوْ قُتِلْتُمْ لَإِلَى ٱللَّهِ تُحْشَرُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wala-in muttum aw qutiltum la-ilaAllahi tuhsharoon
verses.latinId: Wa la'im muttum au qutiltum la'ilallāhi tuḥsyarūn(a).

verses.arabic: فَبِمَا رَحْمَةٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ لِنتَ لَهُمْ ۖ وَلَوْ كُنتَ فَظًّا غَلِيظَ ٱلْقَلْبِ لَٱنفَضُّوا۟ مِنْ حَوْلِكَ ۖ فَٱعْفُ عَنْهُمْ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَشَاوِرْهُمْ فِى ٱلْأَمْرِ ۖ فَإِذَا عَزَمْتَ فَتَوَكَّلْ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ يُحِبُّ ٱلْمُتَوَكِّلِينَ
verses.latinEn: Fabima rahmatin mina Allahilinta lahum walaw kunta faththan ghaleethaalqalbi lanfaddoo min hawlika faAAfuAAanhum wastaghfir lahum washawirhum fee al-amrifa-itha AAazamta fatawakkal AAala Allahiinna Allaha yuhibbu almutawakkileen
verses.latinId: Fabimā raḥmatim minallāhi linta lahum, wa lau kunta faẓẓan galīẓal-qalbi lanfaḍḍū min ḥaulik(a), fa‘fu ‘anhum wastagfir lahum wa syāwirhum fil-amr(i), fa iżā ‘azamta  fa tawakkal ‘alallāh(i), innallāha yuḥibbul-mutawakkilīn(a).

verses.arabic: إِن يَنصُرْكُمُ ٱللَّهُ فَلَا غَالِبَ لَكُمْ ۖ وَإِن يَخْذُلْكُمْ فَمَن ذَا ٱلَّذِى يَنصُرُكُم مِّنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ ۗ وَعَلَى ٱللَّهِ فَلْيَتَوَكَّلِ ٱلْمُؤْمِنُونَ
verses.latinEn: In yansurkumu Allahu falaghaliba lakum wa-in yakhthulkum faman thaallathee yansurukum min baAAdihi waAAala Allahifalyatawakkali almu/minoon
verses.latinId: Iy yanṣurkumullāhu falā gāliba lakum, wa iy yakhżulkum faman żal-lażī yanṣurukum mim ba‘dih(ī),  wa ‘alallāhi falyatawakkalil-mu'minūn(a).

verses.arabic: وَمَا كَانَ لِنَبِىٍّ أَن يَغُلَّ ۚ وَمَن يَغْلُلْ يَأْتِ بِمَا غَلَّ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ ۚ ثُمَّ تُوَفَّىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍ مَّا كَسَبَتْ وَهُمْ لَا يُظْلَمُونَ
verses.latinEn: Wama kana linabiyyin anyaghulla waman yaghlul ya/ti bima ghalla yawma alqiyamatithumma tuwaffa kullu nafsin ma kasabat wahum layuthlamoon
verses.latinId: Wa mā kāna linabiyyin ay yagull(a), wa may yaglul ya'ti  bimā galla yaumal-qiyāmah(ti), ṡumma tuwaffā kullu nafsim mā kasabat wa hum lā yuẓlamūn(a).

verses.arabic: أَفَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ رِضْوَٰنَ ٱللَّهِ كَمَنۢ بَآءَ بِسَخَطٍ مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ وَمَأْوَىٰهُ جَهَنَّمُ ۚ وَبِئْسَ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
verses.latinEn: Afamani ittabaAAa ridwana Allahikaman baa bisakhatin mina Allahi wama/wahujahannamu wabi/sa almaseer
verses.latinId: Afamanittaba‘a riḍwānallāhi kamam bā'a bisakhaṭim minallāhi wa ma'wāhu jahannam(u), wa bi'sal-maṣīr(u),

verses.arabic: هُمْ دَرَجَـٰتٌ عِندَ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ بَصِيرٌۢ بِمَا يَعْمَلُونَ
verses.latinEn: Hum darajatun AAinda Allahiwallahu baseerun bima yaAAmaloon
verses.latinId: Hum darajātun ‘indallāh(i), wallāhu baṣīrum bimā ya‘malūn(a).

verses.arabic: لَقَدْ مَنَّ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ إِذْ بَعَثَ فِيهِمْ رَسُولًا مِّنْ أَنفُسِهِمْ يَتْلُوا۟ عَلَيْهِمْ ءَايَـٰتِهِۦ وَيُزَكِّيهِمْ وَيُعَلِّمُهُمُ ٱلْكِتَـٰبَ وَٱلْحِكْمَةَ وَإِن كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ لَفِى ضَلَـٰلٍ مُّبِينٍ
verses.latinEn: Laqad manna Allahu AAalaalmu/mineena ith baAAatha feehim rasoolan min anfusihimyatloo AAalayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehimwayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba walhikmata wa-inkanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeen
verses.latinId: Laqad mannallāhu ‘alal-mu'minīna iż ba‘aṡa fīhim rasūlam min anfusihim yatlū ‘alaihim āyātihī wa yuzakkīhim wa yu‘allimuhumul-kitāba wal-ḥikmah(ta), wa in kānū min qablu lafī ḍalālim mubīn(in).

verses.arabic: أَوَلَمَّآ أَصَـٰبَتْكُم مُّصِيبَةٌ قَدْ أَصَبْتُم مِّثْلَيْهَا قُلْتُمْ أَنَّىٰ هَـٰذَا ۖ قُلْ هُوَ مِنْ عِندِ أَنفُسِكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ قَدِيرٌ
verses.latinEn: Awa lamma asabatkum museebatunqad asabtum mithlayha qultum anna hathaqul huwa min AAindi anfusikum inna Allaha AAalakulli shay-in qadeer
verses.latinId: Awa lammā aṣābatkum muṣībatun qad aṣabtum miṡlaihā, qultum annā hāżā, qul huwa min ‘indi anfusikum, innallāha ‘alā kulli syai'in qadīr(un).

verses.arabic: وَمَآ أَصَـٰبَكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْتَقَى ٱلْجَمْعَانِ فَبِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلْمُؤْمِنِينَ
verses.latinEn: Wama asabakum yawma iltaqaaljamAAani fabi-ithni Allahi waliyaAAlamaalmu/mineen
verses.latinId: Wa mā aṣābakum yaumal-taqal-jam‘āni fa bi'iżnillāhi wa liya‘lamal-mu'minīn(a).

verses.arabic: وَلِيَعْلَمَ ٱلَّذِينَ نَافَقُوا۟ ۚ وَقِيلَ لَهُمْ تَعَالَوْا۟ قَـٰتِلُوا۟ فِى سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ أَوِ ٱدْفَعُوا۟ ۖ قَالُوا۟ لَوْ نَعْلَمُ قِتَالًا لَّٱتَّبَعْنَـٰكُمْ ۗ هُمْ لِلْكُفْرِ يَوْمَئِذٍ أَقْرَبُ مِنْهُمْ لِلْإِيمَـٰنِ ۚ يَقُولُونَ بِأَفْوَٰهِهِم مَّا لَيْسَ فِى قُلُوبِهِمْ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَكْتُمُونَ
verses.latinEn: WaliyaAAlama allatheena nafaqoowaqeela lahum taAAalaw qatiloo fee sabeeli Allahiawi idfaAAoo qaloo law naAAlamu qitalan lattabaAAnakumhum lilkufri yawma-ithin aqrabu minhum lil-eemaniyaqooloona bi-afwahihim ma laysa fee quloobihim wallahuaAAlamu bima yaktumoon
verses.latinId: Wa liya‘lamal-lażīna nāfaqū, wa qīla lahum  ta‘ālau qātilū fī sabīlillāhi awidfa‘ū, qālū lau na‘lamu qitālal lattaba‘nākum, hum lil-kufri yauma'iżin aqrabu minhum lil-īmān(i), yaqūlūna bi'afwāhihim mā laisa fī qulūbihim, walllāhu a‘lamu bimā yaktumūn(a).
